nhe/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_be.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.

Zampa xictlapehpeni «Xicpa» campa hueli ticpatlaz zo xictlapehpeni tlen ica titlapa para zampa titlapaz. Ica ome momahpil noihqui hueli tictotoxoa quemman titemo titlapaz huan ax ticcahua rayas. Tlen moolinia pan inemah itzintlan quipiya ce raya itlahco pan 100%. Botones para achi huei zo cuecuetztzin neci motzacuiliaj pan 100% tlan quiixpanosquia; zampa xicpacho para tlamis. Botón «Ma nochi neci» inacas quicahua ma neci campa titlapa huan tlen tictlapehpenqui ihiyoca pan itlahco pantalla. Campa tictotoxoa para tiquittaz oncah 100%; pan «Xiquitta» oncah «Inepamitl cehce pixel».

AN Paint quiahcocui icelti tlen ticchiuhqui quemman timoquetza ce tlatoctzin huan quemman tiquisa tlen AN Paint. Nechnextilia «AN Paint icelti quiahcoucqui tlen ticchiuhqui» zo mitzilhuiya tlan axhuelqui quiahcocui. Quemman zampa tictlapoa, mocuepa tlen ticchiuhqui, itoca amatl, tlen tictlapehpenqui para titequitiz, tlen tictlapehpenqui ihiyoca huan formas tlen ayamo tictlamiltia. Tlen AN Paint quiahcocui icelti mocahua san para nopa tequitl. «Amatl» quipiya PNG, JPEG huan HEIC ica calidad tlen hueli ticpatla, huan JPEG XL, WebP huan AVIF ica zo ax ica pérdida tlen pixels. Quemman ticahcocui ica ceyoc itoca, xictlapehpeni tlamantli amatl, quen ticahcocuiz huan campa; «Xicahcocui» zampa quiahcocui nopa campa. Tlan ticquixtia ce copia zo tlan tictequihuia «Xicahcocui huan xictitlani», AN Paint quiahcocui ce copia huan axquipatla campa ticahcocui namantzin ni quimanextia quen ya quiahcoucqui nopa ixcopincayotl. «Xicahcocui huan xictitlani» teipan quitlapoa campa Android quititlani. Citlali inacas itoca amatl quimanextia tlen ticpatlac ayamo tiahcocuih. AN Paint ayic quiahcocui icelti ipan amatl tlen achtohui.

Para tictlapehpeniz: xicchihua ce rectángulo zo ce inepamitl ica momah. Xictotoxo iihtic para tiquihcueniz; xictotoxo cuadrito pan esquina zo itlahco itenno para ticpatlaz ihuexca, zo xictotoxo campa yahualtic para «Xicyahualo». Pehua ica ipatlauhca huan ihuahcapanyo san sejco; xicsehua nopa para hueli ticpatlas ipatlauhca huan ihuahcapanyo ihiyoca. Campa tictotoxoa pan itenno, mopatla ihuexca ica nopa itenno tlen tictlapehpenqui. Tlen tictlapehpenqui ica momah quicahua quen neci iihtic nopa rectángulo campa hueli ticpatla, noihqui tlan ticyahualoa huan tlan AN Paint quiahcocui icelti. Ihuexca huan ángulo neci pan panel tlen hueli ticpatla. «Xictlali tlen tictlapehpenqui pan ixcopincayotl» quitlalia tlen ticpatlac. Hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya, huan AN Paint icelti quiahcocui tlen ayamo tictlamiltia. Tlan ticcopina, tictequi zo tictequi sa ma mocahua tlen tictlapehpenqui, motequihuia ixcopincayotl tlen ticpatlac. Campa tictlapehpenia nochi eltoc pan «Xicpatla → Xictlapehpeni», huan Ctrl+A tequiti ica teclado tlen se lado. Pan itzonco hueli nimantzin tictequi, ticcopina zo ticpepechoa. Máscaras quicahuaj quen neci tlen tictlapehpenqui; ixcopincayotl campa titlapa axquicahua titlachiaz iica.

Inepamitl campa titlapa: xictotoxo campa hueli tiquihcuenia itenno iihtic para tictequiz zo quiyahuac para tichueyiliz. Teipan xictequihui nopa yancuic inepamitl. Campa yancuic motemitia ica ixnezcayotl tlen iica; pixels tlen eltoya axmopatla ininhuexca. Hueli ticcahua ni tequitl zo zampa ticcahua quen eltoya. Para ticpatlaz ihuexca ixcopincayotl, ihuexca campa titlapa zo ce yancuic ixcopincayotl, hueli tictequihuia pixels zo por ciento huan tictlapehpenia tlan ticcahuaz quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo.

Tlahuazantli huihcoltic: xicchihua ce raya huan xictotoxo ome hueltas para ticcuepaz. Polígono: xicpacho cehce esquina; teipan xicpacho ome hueltas nimantzin pan itlamiya esquina zo xictequihui «Xictlamilti ni polígono». Xicsehua «Xictzacua itenno (polígono)» para ticchihuaz rayas tlen mosejcotilia huan axtzactoque. Rectángulo ica esquinas yahualtic: xictlali radio tlen esquina (px) ica tlen moolinia; pan cehce forma radio axhueli quipano itlahco itenno tlen ocachi cototzi. Tlahcuilolli: xicpacho campa titlapa, xictlapehpeni quen neci tlahcuilolli tlen neci ica itlamantli, huan xiquitta nimantzin quen neci. Hueli ticpatla ihuexca, tilahuac, chiquiltic, raya itzintlan, raya ipan itlahco, campa motlalia tlahcuilolli, quempa moiyocatlaliaj líneas huan ce cuadro ica ixnezcayotl tlen iica. «Xitlapa quen ica ixnezcayotl huan atl» eltoc campa titlapa, inacas pincel huan «Xitlapa ica ehecatl»; xicpatla chicahualiztli para ma neci ax tlahuel chicahuac. Tlen moolinia para ihuexca lápiz, pincel huan ocsequi tlen tictequihuia hueli quipano hasta 100 pixels. Lapiz pehua ica 1 pixel huan quielnamiqui ipatlauhca. Xicpacho nomeroh tlen neci para tiquihcuiloz nomeroh melahuac. Yollotl, citlali huan mitl quipiyaj tlen hueli tictlapehpenia para inepamitl huan iihtic quen ocsequi formas. Pan «Xiquitta», campa titlapa ica cursor hueli tictlapoa tlen ica ticpehualtia cursor, quen neci huan tlen ica achi huei neci. Xictotoxo para tictlaliz cursor; xicpacho botón para titlapaz teipan xictotoxo para tiquihcueniz cursor huan titlapaz. Zampa xicpacho para ayoc titlapaz. Tlen hueli ticpatla para pincel huan raya mocahua pan «Xicpa», campa titlapa. «Xiquitta → Campa achi huei neci tlen titlapa» quicahua ma neci achi huei cursor zo campa titlapa, huan hueli ticpatla quen huei neci. Campa ticpatla quen titlapa, noihqui hueli tiquinalaxtia inetenno pixels huan rayas. AN Paint quipiya occe once tlamantli tlahcuilolli; campa neci ininlicencias tiquittaz acquiya quichijqui huan nochi tlen tlanahuatiaj.

«Amatl → Xictlapo ixcopincayotl» quipatla ixcopincayotl campa titlapa ica campa Android quitemaca para tictlapehpeniz. «Xicpa → Xictlali → Cequinoc ixcopincayotl» quipiya amatl tlen dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapas tlen axquipiyaj tlahcuilolli…». Xictlapehpeni ce ixcopincayotl tlen dispositivo, zo xictlapo página tlen ixcopincayotl pan Internet huan xictequihui «Xictequihui ni ixcopincayotl», para tictlaliz ce ixcopincayotl ma mocahua tlapehpentoc ihiyoca. Pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl → Tlen quimanextia acquiya quichiuhqui ixcopincayotl» mocahuaj enlaces campa mocui huan tlahcuiloliztli tlen licencia. Tlan ahci RAM tlen dispositivo hueli quitequihuia, AN Paint quitlapoa ixcopincayotl ica ihuexca tlen achtohui. Tlan monequi, neci ihuexca, itlapohual pixels huan quezqui RAM hueliz monequi para tictlapehpeniz ceyoc ihuexca ica pixels zo por ciento huan tictlapehpeniz tlan ticcahuaz quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo. Amatl tlen achtohui axmopatla.

«Amatl → Tlatecpanilli tlen ixcopincayotl» quitlapoa ce lugar ihiyoca para hasta 20 ixcopincayotl. Xiquintecpana ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzitzi ica inintoca amatl zo quemman quipatlaque. Hueli tictequi ce ixcopincayotl zo tiquintequi miac san ce huelta. «San ce ipatlauhca» zo «San ce ihuahcapanyo» quintlalia nochi ixcopincayotl san ce ipatlauhca zo ihuahcapanyo, zan cehce quicahua quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo. Xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin zo ce tlen ya tictlalih para mopepechoa pan inemah san ce campa itzonco zo itzintlan san ce campa iarrabez. Campa hueli tictlalia melahuac, xictlali esquina tlen itzonco iarrabez ica pixels enteros tlen pehua pan 0; ocsequi mocahuaj campa eltoya huan hueli mocahua ce ipan ceyoc. Tlen ticcalactia teipa neci ipan tlen ticcalactih achtohui. Tlan tiquihcuenia, san ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui mocuepa itzintlan. Ocsequi mocahuaj campa eltoya; tlen mopepechtoque hueli moolinia para quitemitiz campa polihui. «Xiquitta nochi» quipatla quen huei neci. «Xicahcocui (PNG)» quiquixtia nopa tlatecpanilli. «Xicpatla pan Paint» quihuica campa titequiti, huan hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya. AN Paint quipiya zan ce campa titlapa, campa axhueli titlachia iica. Tlatecpanilli tlen ixcopincayotl eltoc ihiyoca.

Pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl» oncah derechos de autor tlen achtohui, acquiya quichijqui tlen motequihuia huan tlamantli tlahcuilolli, nochi tlahcuilolli tlen licencia huan nochi código fuente tlen ni versión. Hueli tictotoxoa tlahcuilolli tlen licencia; nopa botones para ticcopinaz nochi, tiquittaz ocsequi tlanahuatilli zo tictlamiltiz axmooliniaj.

Ihuexca huan ángulo neci pan panel tlen hueli ticpatla. «Xictlali tlen tictlapehpenqui pan ixcopincayotl» quitlalia tlen ticpatlac. Hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya, huan AN Paint icelti quiahcocui tlen ayamo tictlamiltia. Tlan ticcopina, tictequi zo tictequi sa ma mocahua tlen tictlapehpenqui, motequihuia ixcopincayotl tlen ticpatlac. Campa tictlapehpenia nochi eltoc pan «Xicpatla → Xictlapehpeni», huan Ctrl+A tequiti ica teclado tlen se lado. Pan itzonco hueli nimantzin tictequi, ticcopina zo ticpepechoa. Máscaras quicahuaj quen neci tlen tictlapehpenqui; ixcopincayotl campa titlapa axquicahua titlachiaz iica.

Inepamitl campa titlapa: xictotoxo campa hueli tiquihcuenia itenno iihtic para tictequiz zo quiyahuac para tichueyiliz. Teipan xictequihui nopa yancuic inepamitl. Campa yancuic motemitia ica ixnezcayotl tlen iica; pixels tlen eltoya axmopatla ininhuexca. Hueli ticcahua ni tequitl zo zampa ticcahua quen eltoya. Para ticpatlaz ihuexca ixcopincayotl, ihuexca campa titlapa zo ce yancuic ixcopincayotl, hueli tictequihuia pixels zo por ciento huan tictlapehpenia tlan ticcahuaz quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo.

Tlahuazantli huihcoltic: xicchihua ce raya huan xictotoxo ome hueltas para ticcuepaz. Polígono: xicpacho cehce esquina; teipan xicpacho ome hueltas nimantzin pan itlamiya esquina zo xictequihui «Xictlamilti ni polígono». Xicsehua «Xictzacua itenno (polígono)» para ticchihuaz rayas tlen mosejcotilia huan axtzactoque. Rectángulo ica esquinas yahualtic: xictlali radio tlen esquina (px) ica tlen moolinia; pan cehce forma radio axhueli quipano itlahco itenno tlen ocachi cototzi. Tlahcuilolli: xicpacho campa titlapa, xictlapehpeni quen neci tlahcuilolli tlen neci ica itlamantli, huan xiquitta nimantzin quen neci. Hueli ticpatla ihuexca, tilahuac, chiquiltic, raya itzintlan, raya ipan itlahco, campa motlalia tlahcuilolli, quempa moiyocatlaliaj líneas huan ce cuadro ica ixnezcayotl tlen iica. «Xitlapa quen ica ixnezcayotl huan atl» eltoc campa titlapa, inacas pincel huan «Xitlapa ica ehecatl»; xicpatla chicahualiztli para ma neci ax tlahuel chicahuac. Tlen moolinia para ihuexca lápiz, pincel huan ocsequi tlen tictequihuia hueli quipano hasta 100 pixels. Lapiz pehua ica 1 pixel huan quielnamiqui ipatlauhca. Xicpacho nomeroh tlen neci para tiquihcuiloz nomeroh melahuac. Yollotl, citlali huan mitl quipiyaj tlen hueli tictlapehpenia para inepamitl huan iihtic quen ocsequi formas. Pan «Xiquitta», campa titlapa ica cursor hueli tictlapoa tlen ica ticpehualtia cursor, quen neci huan tlen ica achi huei neci. Xictotoxo para tictlaliz cursor; xicpacho botón para titlapaz teipan xictotoxo para tiquihcueniz cursor huan titlapaz. Zampa xicpacho para ayoc titlapaz. Tlen hueli ticpatla para pincel huan raya mocahua pan «Xicpa», campa titlapa. «Xiquitta → Campa achi huei neci tlen titlapa» quicahua ma neci achi huei cursor zo campa titlapa, huan hueli ticpatla quen huei neci. Campa ticpatla quen titlapa, noihqui hueli tiquinalaxtia inetenno pixels huan rayas. AN Paint quipiya occe once tlamantli tlahcuilolli; campa neci ininlicencias tiquittaz acquiya quichijqui huan nochi tlen tlanahuatiaj.

«Amatl → Xictlapo ixcopincayotl…» quipatla ixcopincayotl campa titlapa ica campa Android quitemaca para tictlapehpeniz. «Xicpa → Xictlali → Cequinoc ixcopincayotl» quipiya amatl tlen dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapas para tictlalis amatlapohualiztli (Blank maps)…». Xictlapehpeni ce ixcopincayotl tlen dispositivo, zo xictlapo página tlen ixcopincayotl pan Internet huan xictequihui «Xictequihui ni ixcopincayotl», para tictlaliz ce ixcopincayotl ma mocahua tlapehpentoc ihiyoca. Pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl → Acquiya quichiuhqui ixcopincayotl huan canin mocui» mocahuaj enlaces campa mocui huan tlahcuiloliztli tlen licencia. Tlan ahci RAM tlen dispositivo hueli quitequihuia, AN Paint quitlapoa ixcopincayotl ica ihuexca tlen achtohui. Tlan monequi, neci ihuexca, itlapohual pixels huan quezqui RAM hueliz monequi para tictlapehpeniz ceyoc ihuexca ica «Pixels» zo «Quezqui tlen 100 (por ciento)» huan tictlapehpeniz tlan ticcahuaz quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo. Amatl tlen achtohui axmopatla.

«Amatl → Tlatecpanilli tlen ixcopincayotl» quitlapoa ce lugar ihiyoca para hasta 20 ixcopincayotl. Xiquintecpana ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzitzi ica inintoca amatl zo quemman quipatlaque. Hueli tictequi ce ixcopincayotl zo tiquintequi miac san ce huelta. «Cencah ipatlauhca» zo «Cencah ihuahcapanyo» quintlalia nochi ixcopincayotl san ce ipatlauhca zo ihuahcapanyo, zan cehce quicahua quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo. Xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin zo ce tlen ya tictlalih para mopepechoa pan inemah san ce campa itzonco zo itzintlan san ce campa iarrabez. Campa hueli tictlalia melahuac, xictlali esquina tlen itzonco iarrabez ica pixels enteros tlen pehua pan 0; ocsequi mocahuaj campa eltoya huan hueli mocahua ce ipan ceyoc. Tlen ticcalactia teipa neci ipan tlen ticcalactih achtohui. Tlan tiquihcuenia, san ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui mocuepa itzintlan. Ocsequi mocahuaj campa eltoya; tlen mopepechtoque hueli moolinia para quitemitiz campa polihui. «Xicmanexti nochi» quipatla quen huei neci. «Xicahcocui PNG» quiquixtia nopa tlatecpanilli. «Xicpatla pan Paint» quihuica campa titequiti, huan hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya. AN Paint quipiya zan ce campa titlapa, campa axhueli titlachia iica. Tlatecpanilli tlen ixcopincayotl eltoc ihiyoca.

Pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl» oncah derechos de autor tlen achtohui, acquiya quichijqui tlen motequihuia huan tlamantli tlahcuilolli, nochi tlahcuilolli tlen licencia huan nochi código fuente tlen ni versión. Hueli tictotoxoa tlahcuilolli tlen licencia; nopa botones para ticcopinaz nochi, tiquittaz ocsequi tlanahuatilli zo tictlamiltiz axmooliniaj.

nch/gallery_description.source: Tap Use image to insert immediately. Copy credit beside an image copies its title, publisher, source and licence for your publication. Catrobat's original artwork is CC BY-SA 4.0; keep any separately named creators, copyright and other source notices. Describe your edits and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible licence. Edit credits lets you add these details; inserted sources remain under File → About, licences & credits → Image credits.

nch/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
nch/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.previous:
Xijtali 20 ixkopinali o menos ica campa Android mitzcahuilía xijtapejpeni amatl. Tlatzintla nesi pilixkopinali, inintoca amatl, ihuexca sesen ixkopinali teipa quema tijtequi huan quema tijpata ica ‘San se ipatajca’ o ‘San se ihuejcapanca’, huan quema quipatac amatl, sinta campa huala amatl quitemaca ni tajcuiloli. Xijsentili ica inintoca amatl o quema quipatac. Ya ni amo quiijcuenía ixkopinali cati ya tijtlalij.

Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan se pilixkopinali para xijtapejpeni. ‘Xijtequi ixkopinali’ quitequi san nopa ixkopinali. Quema tiquintequi miyac san se huelta, xijtlali quesqui pixels o por ciento tijquixtis ipan ininteno ixkopinali cati tijtapejpenijtoc. Xijtilana campa hueli tiquijcuenía iteno o xiquijcuilo quesqui tijquixtis. ‘Xijcahua nochi ixkopinali’ quicahua iteno quen eltoya. Quema tijtequi, amo mopata amatl cati achtohui, huan hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya.

Xijcahua momajpil se talojtzi ipan pilixkopinali, o xijtilana ixkopinali cati ya eltoc ipan ni tequit; teipa xijcahua ipan iteno cati nesi más. Campa achtohui nesi ixkopinali huan hueli tiquita cati eltoc iica, tiquitas canque mero mocahuas quema mopepechoa. Sinta mopepechoa ipan inejmat, nejnemi san se ipan iixco; sinta mopepechoa tlatzintla, nejnemi san se ipan iarraves. Nojquiya hueli xijtapejpeni se pilixkopinali huan teipa xijpacho se machiotl +. Quema mopepechoa, ixkopinali cati achtohui pehua ipan (0, 0). Sinta tijtequi ixkopinali campa mopepechojtoque sequinoc, huelis moijcuenise. Quema mopepechoa, amo hueli mocahua se ixkopinali ipan seyoc.

Xijtapejpeni se ixkopinali huan xijtequihui campa tijtlalía canque mero elis para tijtlalis X/Y ten esquina iixco ipan iarraves, ica pixels enteros cati pehua ipan 0. Sequinoc ixkopinali mocahuaj canque eltoyaj, huan hueli mocahua se ipan seyoc.

‘San se ipatajca’ huan ‘San se ihuejcapanca’ quincahuaj nochi ixkopinali ica san se ipatajca o ihuejcapanca, pero sesen quicahua quen eltoya ipatajca ica ihuejcapanca. Xijtapejpeni pixels, por ciento, cati más pilquentzi o cati más hueyi. Sempa xijcahua ihuexca cati achtohui para ayocmo nochi quipiyase san se ihuexca; mocahua cati tijtequi.

Quema tiquijcuenía, san ixkopinali cati tijtapejpenijtoc mocuepa tlatzintla. Sequinoc mocahuaj canque eltoyaj; cati mopepechojtoque huelis moijcuenise para quitemitise canque polihui. Quema tijquixtía, san nopa ixkopinali mopoloa. ‘Naja xijcahua quen eltoya’ huan ‘Naja xijchiua’ quicuepaj cati mopatac. Xijtilana se ixkopinali cati ya eltoc para tiquijcuenis; xijtilana campa amo tlen onca para tijpatas campa tiquita. Xijnechco o xijiyocatali ome momajpil para tijpatas quen hueyi nesi. ‘Ma nochi nesi’ quipata quen hueyi nesi para tiquitas nochi ni tequit; amo quipata ihuexca ixkopinali cati AN Paint quichihuas.

‘Xicajocui PNG’ quiajocui nopa ixkopinali sentili. ‘Xijpata ipan Paint’ quihuica campa titlaixkopina para quipatac cati eltoya; hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya. Sinta monequi más RAM que cati hueli motequihuía, xijtapejpeni se copia cati más pilquentzi sinta AN Paint mitzmacas nopa opción. Sinta hasta se copia tlahuel pilquentzi quinequi más RAM, AN Paint mitzilhuis amo onca RAM cati monequi huan amo mitzcahuilis xijtapejpeni ihuexca. Amatl cati achtohui amo mopata. Ni tequit mocajocui ipan dispositivo huan sempa motapo quema timocuepa.

Nican motequihuía san nopa Catrobat/AGPL huan tajcuiloli ten ajquiya quichijqui cati motequihuía, quen nesi campa titlaixkopina ipan ‘Amatl → Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit’.

nch/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
nch/ui_help23.previous: Xijtapejpeni se pestaña para tiquitas cati hueli tijchihuas ipan ya. ‘Xiquita’ pehua ica ‘Xijtilana ixkopinali para tiquitas’; ‘Xitlaixkopina’ quipiya cati ica titlaixkopina, ‘Xitlapejpena’ huan ‘Xijtali’. Quema xijtilana para tiquitas, amo titlaixkopina; xijnechco o xijiyocatali ome momajpil para tijpatas quen hueyi nesi. Nopa flecha inahuac pestañas quitsacua nopa panel. Nochi cati ica titequiti quipiya itoca. ‘Xijpata’ quipata cati tijtapejpenijtoc, inepamitl campa titlaixkopina, ihuexca o ixkopinali. ‘Tapali’ quitapejpenía cati iixpa huan iica; ‘Xijpata iixpa huan iica’ quincuepa huan yayahuic / chipahuac sempa quintalía. Nimantzi nesi tapali cati tijtapejpenijtoc. ‘Xijtequihui ni tapali’ quicahua ya; sinta tijcahua ni tequit, sempa mocahua tapali cati achtohui. Xijtlali tapali o xijpacho se lugar cati amo quipiya tapali para xijtapejpeni huan xicajocui se tapali. Xijcahua momajpil se talojtzi ipan tapali cati mocajocui para tijpatas o tijquixtis. ‘Más cati hueli tijpatas’, inahuac yayahuic / chipahuac, quitapo campa hueli tijpatas miyac ten tapali. ‘Inepamitl sesen pixel’ nojquiya quinextía reglas ica pixels ten ixkopinali; quema titlaixkopina ica cursor, nesi x/y campa eltoc amantzi inahuac campa tijpata quen hueyi nesi. Quema tijcajocuía ica seyoc itoca, xijtapejpeni tlamantli amatl, quen quentzi bytes quipiyas huan campa tijcajocuis; ‘Xicajocui’ sempa quiajocui nopa campa ica san se cati tijtapejpenij. Quema tijquixtía se copia, AN Paint quichihua ICO, ixkopinali ica ASCII o tajcuiloli Base64, huan amo quimachotía ixkopinali quen ya quiajocui. ‘Xicajocui huan xijtitani’ quiajocui se copia huan teipa quitapo campa Android quititani. Amo quipata campa tijcajocuía amantzi. Ipan ‘Xitlaixkopina → Xijtali → Sequinoc ixkopinali’ onca amatl ten dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan ‘Wikimedia Commons · Mapas cati amo quipiyaj tajcuiloli…’. Ixkopinali cati tijtlalía mocahua tapejpenili; hueli tiquita campa tiquijcuenía, masque eltoc caltenco ten campa titlaixkopina. Quema tijcahua ma calaqui ixkopinali ipan campa titlaixkopina, mopata canque eltoc; ‘Ihuexca cati achtohui’ quicahua ihuexca quen eltoya. Quema sempa tijtapo AN Paint, cati quiajocui iselti quicuepa cati tijchijqui huan cati tijtequihuis ica ‘Naja xijcahua quen eltoya’ huan ‘Naja xijchiua’. Ipan ‘Amatl’ nojquiya onca ‘Tequit campa mosentilia ixkopinali’, quen tinequis tijtequihuis huan ‘Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit’. Quema tijtlalía tajcuiloli, hueli tijtlalía ten iarraves hasta inejmat o ten iixco hasta tlatzintla.

Quema sempa tijtapo AN Paint, cati quiajocui iselti quicuepa cati tijchijqui huan cati tijtequihuis ica ‘Naja xijcahua quen eltoya’ huan ‘Naja xijchiua’. Ipan ‘Amatl’ nojquiya onca ‘Tequit campa mosentilia ixkopinali’, quen tinequis tijtequihuis huan ‘Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit’. Quema tijtlalía tajcuiloli, hueli tijtlalía ten iarraves hasta inejmat o ten iixco hasta tlatzintla.

nch/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_be.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.
nch/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_be.previous:
Xijtapejpeni ‘Xiquita’, ‘Xitlaixkopina’, ‘Amatl’, ‘Xijpata’ o ‘Tapali’ para tiquitas cati hueli tijchihuas ipan nopa pestaña. Nopa flecha inahuac pestañas quitsacua o sempa quitapo panel. Sinta pantalla eltoc ten iixco hasta tlatzintla, pestañas huan cati ica titequiti eltoque ten iarraves hasta inejmat; xijtilana para tiquitas sequinoc. Sinta pantalla eltoc ten iarraves hasta inejmat, pestañas huan cati achtohui tijtequihuía eltoque ipan iarraves ten iixco hasta tlatzintla. ‘Xitlaixkopina’ quipiya campa titlaixkopina, ‘Xitlapejpena’ huan ‘Xijtali’. Campa titlaixkopina onca lápiz, ‘Xitlaixkopina ica pincel’, acuarela huan ‘Xitlaixkopina ica ajacatl’. Ipan ‘Xitlapejpena’ hueli tijtapejpenía se rectángulo o se inepamitl cati tijchijqui ica momaj. Ipan ‘Xijtali’ onca rayas, figuras huan tajcuiloli. Xijpacho se grupo para sempa tijtequihuis cati AN Paint quielnamiqui huan tiquitas nochi cati ica titequiti huan cati hueli tijpatas. Sinta pantalla eltoc ten iixco hasta tlatzintla, nesi tlatzintla ten cati ica titequiti; sinta eltoc ten iarraves hasta inejmat, nesi ipan inejmat. Sempa xijpacho nopa grupo para tijtsacuas o tijtapos cati eltoc ipan ya. Sesen grupo quielnamiqui cati tijtequihuij hasta tijsacuas AN Paint. Xijtilana panel para tiquitas más cati hueli tijpatas. Iixco nesi itoca amatl huan cati nimantzi hueli tijchihuas. Licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui: ‘Amatl → Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit’.

Ipan ‘Tapali’ nesi tapali iixpa huan iica (FG/BG), ‘Xijpata iixpa huan iica’, yayahuic / chipahuac huan ‘Más cati hueli tijpatas’. Xijpacho campa nesi tapali iixpa o iica para tijpatas. Tlatzintla ten encabezado eltoc campa tijtapejpenía tapali cati nochipa motequihuía huan tapali cati mocajocui. Xijpacho se tapali cati nochipa motequihuía para iixpa; xijcahua momajpil se talojtzi para iica. Nahui lugares más ipan inejmat quicajocuía tapali cati sanoc tijtequihuij; xijpacho para iixpa o xijcahua momajpil para iica. Campa tijpata tapali onca campa tijtapejpenis tapali, panal huan ‘Más cati hueli tijpatas’. Ipan nopa último onca tapali cati tlatlalili, tapali cati yahualtic, RGB, HSV, HSL huan chicuasen machiotl hex. Tapali cati tijtapejpenijtoc pehua ica morado cati amo yayahuic #5B67FF, oro #FFD700, plata #C0C0C0 huan cobre #B87333. Xijpacho se tapali cati mocajocui para iixpa; xijcahua momajpil se talojtzi para tijtequihuis iica, tijpatas o tijquixtis. Xijtlali tapali o xijpacho campa amo quipiya tapali para tijtapos campa hueli ticajocuis se tapali. Campa titlaixkopina amo mitzcahuilía xiquita cati eltoc iica. Sinta tijtapo se ixkopinali para campa titlaixkopina, nopa partes campa hueli tiquita iica motemitíaj ica tapali iica (BG). Sinta tijtlalía se ixkopinali, mocahua tapejpenili iselti; campa hueli tiquita iica quinextía ixkopinali cati ya eltoc quema tijtlalía. Ixkopinali ten Wikimedia Commons quipiyaj chipahuac iica achtohui tijtlalía. Amatl cati achtohui amo mopata.

‘Xiquita → Xijtilana ixkopinali para tiquitas’: xijtilana ica se momajpil para tijpatas campa tiquita; xijnechco o xijiyocatali ome momajpil para tijpatas quen hueyi nesi, huan xijtilana para tijpatas campa tiquita. Sempa xijtapejpeni ‘Xitlaixkopina’ campa hueli tijpatas o xijtapejpeni se cati ica titlaixkopina para sempa titlaixkopinas. Nojquiya hueli xijtilana ica ome momajpil campa titlaixkopina, huan amo tijcahua rayas. Cati moijcuenía nepa tlatzintla ipan inejmat quipiya se raya tlatlajco ipan 100%. Botones para más hueyi o más pilquentzi nesi moquetzaj ipan 100% quema quipanosquíaj; sempa xijpacho para tijtequihuis noja. Botón ‘Ma nochi nesi’ inahuac quicahua ma nesi campa titlaixkopina huan cati tijtapejpenijtoc iselti tlatlajco. Campa xijtilana para tiquitas nojquiya onca 100%; ipan ‘Xiquita’ onca ‘Inepamitl sesen pixel’.

AN Paint quiajocui iselti cati tijchijqui quema timuquetza se talojtzi huan quema tiquisa ten AN Paint. Nesi cati quiijtohua ya mocajocui, o mitzilhuiya sinta amo huelqui quiajocuis. Quema sempa tijtapo, mocuepa cati tijchijqui, itoca amatl, cati tijtapejpenij para titequitis, cati tijtapejpenijtoc iselti huan figuras cati ayemo tijtlamiltía. Cati AN Paint quiajocui iselti mocahua san para ni tequit. ‘Amatl’ quipiya PNG, JPEG huan HEIC ica calidad cati hueli tijpata, huan JPEG XL, WebP huan AVIF ica o amo ica pérdida ten pixels. Quema tijcajocuía ica seyoc itoca, xijtapejpeni tlamantli amatl, quen tijcajocuis huan campa; ‘Xicajocui’ sempa quiajocui nopa campa. Quema tijquixtía se copia o tijtequihuía ‘Xicajocui huan xijtitani’, AN Paint quiajocui se copia huan amo quipata campa tijcajocuía ni quinextía quen ya mocajocui nopa ixkopinali. ‘Xicajocui huan xijtitani’ teipa quitapo campa Android quititani. Sitalitl inahuac itoca amatl quinextía oncac cati tijpatac huan ayemo tijcajocuij. AN Paint amo quipata amatl cati achtohui quema quiajocui iselti.

Para xitlapejpena: xijchihua se rectángulo o se inepamitl ica momaj. Xijtilana itic para tiquijcuenis; xijtilana cuadrito ipan esquina o tlatlajco iteno para tijpatas ihuexca, o xijtilana campa yahualtic para tijyahualos. Achtohui ipatajca huan ihuejcapanca mopataj san sejco; xijsehuis ya para hueli tijpatas sesen iselti. Quema xijtilana ipan iteno, ihuexca mopata ica nopa iteno cati tijtapejpenij. Cati tijtapejpenij ica momaj quicahua quen nesi itic nopa cuadro campa tijpata, masque ya tijyahualojqui o AN Paint quiajoctoc iselti. Ihuexca huan ángulo nesi ipan panel cati hueli tijpatas. ‘Xijtali cati tijtapejpenijtoc ipan ixkopinali’ quitalía cati tijpatac. Hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya huan AN Paint quiajocui iselti cati ayemo tijtlamiltía. Quema tijchihua se copia, tijtequi o tijcahua san cati tijtapejpenijtoc, motequihuía ixkopinali cati tijpatac. Campa tijtapejpenía nochi eltoc ipan ‘Xijpata → Xitlapejpena’; Ctrl+A tequiti ica se teclado cati tijpepechoa. Iixco hueli nimantzi tijtequi, tijchihua se copia o tijpepechoa. Máscaras quicahuaj quen nesi cati tijtapejpenijtoc; noja amo hueli tiquita cati eltoc iica ten ixkopinali campa titlaixkopina.

Inepamitl campa titlaixkopina: xijtilana campa hueli tiquijcuenía iteno itic para xijtequi o caltenco para xijhueyili. Nochi iteno hueli mopata; teipa xijtequihui nopa yancuic inepamitl. Campa yancuic motemitía ica tapali iica; amo mopata ininhuexca pixels cati eltoyaj. Hueli tijcahua ni tequit o sempa tijcahua quen eltoya. Campa tijpata ihuexca ixkopinali, ihuexca campa titlaixkopina o tijchihua se yancuic ixkopinali, nojquiya hueli tijtequihuía pixels o por ciento, huan tijtapejpenía sinta tijcahuas quen eltoya ipatajca ica ihuejcapanca.

Raya cati huijcoltic: xijchihua se raya huan xijtilana ome huelta para tijcuepas. Polígono: xijpacho sesen esquina; teipa xijpacho ome huelta nimantzi ipan itlamiya esquina o xijtequihui cati quitlamiltía polígono. Xijsehui cati quitsacua polígono para tijchihuas rayas cati mosentilíaj huan amo motzacua. Rectángulo ica esquinas yahualtic: xijtlali radio (px) ica cati moijcuenía; ipan sesen figura radio amo hueli quipanos tlatlajco ten iteno más cototzi. Tajcuiloli: xijpacho campa titlaixkopina, xijtapejpeni quen nesi letras cati AN Paint quinextía quen melahuac nesij huan xiquita nimantzi quen nesi. Hueli tijpatas ihuexca, tilahuac, chicoltic, raya tlatzintla, raya ipan tlatlajco, campa motlali tajcuiloli, quesqui moiyocatali rayas huan se cuadro ten tajcuiloli ica tapali iica. Acuarela eltoc campa titlaixkopina inahuac pincel huan ‘Xitlaixkopina ica ajacatl’; xijpata ichicahualis para ma nesi amo tlahuel chicahuac. Cati moijcuenía para ihuexca lápiz, pincel huan sequinoc cati tijtequihuía hasta 100 pixels. Lápiz pehua ica 1 pixel huan quielnamiqui ipatajca. Xijpacho nopa número cati nesi para tiquijcuilos se número melahuac. Yolt, sitalitl huan flecha quipiyaj cati hueli tijtapejpenía para ininpan huan inintic quen sequinoc figuras. Ipan ‘Xiquita’, ‘Quen titlaixkopinas ica cursor’ quitapo cati hueli tijpatas para tijpehualtis cursor, quen nesi huan campa más hueyi nesi. Xijtilana para tijtlalis cursor; xijpacho botón para titlaixkopinas, teipa xijtilana para tiquijcuenis cursor huan titlaixkopinas. Sempa xijpacho para ayocmo titlaixkopinas. Cati hueli tijpatas para pincel huan rayas mocahua ipan ‘Xitlaixkopina’, campa titlaixkopina. ‘Xiquita → Campa más hueyi nesi cati titlaixkopina’ quicahua ma nesi más hueyi cursor o campa titlaixkopina, huan hueli tijpata quen hueyi nesi. ‘Quenicatza titlaixkopinas’ nojquiya quipiya cati quichihua ma nesi más alaxtic iteno pixels huan rayas. AN Paint quipiya seyoc once tlamantli letras; ipan ‘Licencias ten quen nesij letras’ tiquitas ajquiya quichijqui huan nochi cati tlanahuatíaj.

‘Amatl → Xijtapo ixkopinali’ quipata ixkopinali campa titlaixkopina ica campa Android mitzcahuilía xijtapejpeni. ‘Xitlaixkopina → Xijtali → Sequinoc ixkopinali’ quipiya amatl ten dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan ‘Wikimedia Commons · Mapas cati amo quipiyaj tajcuiloli…’. Xijtapejpeni se ixkopinali ten dispositivo o xijtapo campa nesi ixkopinali ipan internet huan xijpacho ‘Xijtequihui ni ixkopinali’ para tijtlalis huan ma mocahua tapejpenili iselti. Ipan ‘Amatl → Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit → Ajquiya quichijqui ixkopinali’ mocahuaj enlaces canque hualajqui huan tajcuiloli ten licencia. Sinta ajsi RAM cati dispositivo hueli quitequihuía, ixkopinali motapo ica ihuexca cati achtohui. Sinta monequi, nesi ihuexca, quesqui pixels huan quesqui RAM monequis, para xijtapejpeni seyoc ihuexca ica pixels o por ciento. Hueli tijtapejpenía sinta tijcahuas quen eltoya ipatajca ica ihuejcapanca. Amatl cati achtohui amo mopata.

‘Amatl → Tequit campa mosentilia ixkopinali’ quitapo se lugar iselti para 20 ixkopinali o menos. Xijsentili pilixkopinali ica inintoca amatl o quema quipatac. Hueli tijtequi se ixkopinali o tiquintequi miyac san se huelta. ‘San se ipatajca’ o ‘San se ihuejcapanca’ quincahuaj nochi ixkopinali ica san se ipatajca o ihuejcapanca, pero sesen quicahua quen eltoya ipatajca ica ihuejcapanca. Xijtilana se pilixkopinali o se ixkopinali cati ya tijtlalij para mopepechoa ipan inejmat san se ipan iixco, o tlatzintla san se ipan iarraves. Campa hueli tijtlalía canque mero elis, xijtlali esquina iixco ipan iarraves ica pixels enteros cati pehua ipan 0; sequinoc mocahuaj canque eltoyaj huan hueli mocahua se ipan seyoc. Cati tijtlalía teipa nesi ipan cati tijtlalij achtohui. Quema tiquijcuenía, san ixkopinali cati tijtapejpenijtoc mocuepa tlatzintla. Sequinoc mocahuaj canque eltoyaj; cati mopepechojtoque huelis moijcuenise para quitemitise canque polihui. ‘Ma nochi nesi’ quipata quen hueyi nesi. ‘Xicajocui PNG’ quiquixtía ixkopinali sentili. ‘Xijpata ipan Paint’ quihuica campa titequiti para tijpatas huan hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya. AN Paint quipiya san se campa titlaixkopina, campa amo hueli tiquita cati eltoc iica. Tequit campa mosentilia ixkopinali eltoc iselti.

Ipan panel ‘Amatl → Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit’ onca derechos de autor cati achtohui, ajquiya quichijqui cati motequihuía huan tlamantli letras, nochi tajcuiloli ten licencia huan nochi código fuente ten ni versión. Hueli tijtilana tajcuiloli ten licencia; amo moijcuenía botones para tijchihuas copia ten nochi, tiquitas seyoc tlanahuatili o tijtlamiltis.

Sinta tijtlalía se ixkopinali, mocahua tapejpenili iselti; campa quipiya transparencia quinextía ixkopinali cati ya eltoc quema tijtlalía. ‘Xiquita → Xijtilana ixkopinali para tiquitas’: xijtilana ica se momajpil para tijpatas campa tiquita; xijnechco o xijiyocatali ome momajpil para tijpatas quen hueyi nesi, huan xijtilana para tijpatas campa tiquita. Sempa xijtapejpeni ‘Xitlaixkopina’ campa hueli tijpatas o xijtapejpeni se cati ica titlaixkopina para sempa titlaixkopinas. Nojquiya hueli xijtilana ica ome momajpil campa titlaixkopina, huan amo tijcahua rayas. Cati moijcuenía nepa tlatzintla ipan inejmat quipiya se raya tlatlajco ipan 100%. Botones para más hueyi o más pilquentzi nesi moquetzaj ipan 100% quema quipanosquíaj; sempa xijpacho para tijtequihuis noja. Botón ‘Ma nochi nesi’ inahuac quicahua ma nesi campa titlaixkopina huan cati tijtapejpenijtoc iselti tlatlajco. Campa xijtilana para tiquitas nojquiya onca 100%; ipan ‘Xiquita’ onca ‘Inepamitl sesen pixel’.

AN Paint quiajocui iselti cati tijchijqui quema timuquetza se talojtzi huan quema tiquisa ten AN Paint. Nesi cati quiijtohua ya mocajocui, o mitzilhuiya sinta amo huelqui quiajocuis. Quema sempa tijtapo, mocuepa cati tijchijqui, itoca amatl, cati tijtapejpenij para titequitis, cati tijtapejpenijtoc iselti huan figuras cati ayemo tijtlamiltía. Cati AN Paint quiajocui iselti mocahua san para ni tequit. ‘Amatl’ quipiya PNG, JPEG huan HEIC ica calidad cati hueli tijpata, huan JPEG XL, WebP huan AVIF ica o amo ica pérdida ten pixels. Quema tijcajocuía ica seyoc itoca, xijtapejpeni tlamantli amatl, quen tijcajocuis huan campa; ‘Xicajocui’ sempa quiajocui nopa campa. Quema tijquixtía se copia o tijtequihuía ‘Xicajocui huan xijtitani’, AN Paint quiajocui se copia huan amo quipata campa tijcajocuía ni quinextía quen ya mocajocui nopa ixkopinali. ‘Xicajocui huan xijtitani’ teipa quitapo campa Android quititani. Sitalitl inahuac itoca amatl quinextía oncac cati tijpatac huan ayemo tijcajocuij. AN Paint amo quipata amatl cati achtohui quema quiajocui iselti.

Para xitlapejpena: xijchihua se rectángulo o se inepamitl ica momaj. Xijtilana itic para tiquijcuenis; xijtilana cuadrito ipan esquina o tlatlajco iteno para tijpatas ihuexca, o xijtilana campa yahualtic para tijyahualos. Achtohui ipatajca huan ihuejcapanca mopataj san sejco; xijsehuis ya para hueli tijpatas sesen iselti. Quema xijtilana ipan iteno, ihuexca mopata ica nopa iteno cati tijtapejpenij. Cati tijtapejpenij ica momaj quicahua quen nesi itic nopa cuadro campa tijpata, masque ya tijyahualojqui o AN Paint quiajoctoc iselti. Ihuexca huan ángulo nesi ipan panel cati hueli tijpatas. ‘Xijtali cati tijtapejpenijtoc ipan ixkopinali’ quitalía cati tijpatac. Hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya huan AN Paint quiajocui iselti cati ayemo tijtlamiltía. Quema tijchihua se copia, tijtequi o tijcahua san cati tijtapejpenijtoc, motequihuía ixkopinali cati tijpatac. Campa tijtapejpenía nochi eltoc ipan ‘Xijpata → Xitlapejpena’; Ctrl+A tequiti ica se teclado cati tijpepechoa. Iixco hueli nimantzi tijtequi, tijchihua se copia o tijpepechoa. Máscaras quicahuaj quen nesi cati tijtapejpenijtoc; noja amo hueli tiquita cati eltoc iica ten ixkopinali campa titlaixkopina.

Inepamitl campa titlaixkopina: xijtilana campa hueli tiquijcuenía iteno itic para xijtequi o caltenco para xijhueyili. Nochi iteno hueli mopata; teipa xijtequihui nopa yancuic inepamitl. Campa yancuic motemitía ica tapali iica; amo mopata ininhuexca pixels cati eltoyaj. Hueli tijcahua ni tequit o sempa tijcahua quen eltoya. Campa tijpata ihuexca ixkopinali, ihuexca campa titlaixkopina o tijchihua se yancuic ixkopinali, nojquiya hueli tijtequihuía pixels o por ciento, huan tijtapejpenía sinta tijcahuas quen eltoya ipatajca ica ihuejcapanca.

Raya cati huijcoltic: xijchihua se raya huan xijtilana ome huelta para tijcuepas. Polígono: xijpacho sesen esquina; teipa xijpacho ome huelta nimantzi ipan itlamiya esquina o xijtequihui cati quitlamiltía polígono. Xijsehui cati quitsacua polígono para tijchihuas rayas cati mosentilíaj huan amo motzacua. Rectángulo ica esquinas yahualtic: xijtlali radio (px) ica cati moijcuenía; ipan sesen figura radio amo hueli quipanos tlatlajco ten iteno más cototzi. Tajcuiloli: xijpacho campa titlaixkopina, xijtapejpeni quen nesi letras cati AN Paint quinextía quen melahuac nesij huan xiquita nimantzi quen nesi. Hueli tijpatas ihuexca, tilahuac, chicoltic, raya tlatzintla, raya ipan tlatlajco, campa motlali tajcuiloli, quesqui moiyocatali rayas huan se cuadro ten tajcuiloli ica tapali iica. Acuarela eltoc campa titlaixkopina inahuac pincel huan ‘Xitlaixkopina ica ajacatl’; xijpata ichicahualis para ma nesi amo tlahuel chicahuac. Cati moijcuenía para ihuexca lápiz, pincel huan sequinoc cati tijtequihuía hasta 100 pixels. Lápiz pehua ica 1 pixel huan quielnamiqui ipatajca. Xijpacho nopa número cati nesi para tiquijcuilos se número melahuac. Yolt, sitalitl huan flecha quipiyaj cati hueli tijtapejpenía para ininpan huan inintic quen sequinoc figuras. Ipan ‘Xiquita’, ‘Quen titlaixkopinas ica cursor’ quitapo cati hueli tijpatas para tijpehualtis cursor, quen nesi huan campa más hueyi nesi. Xijtilana para tijtlalis cursor; xijpacho botón para titlaixkopinas, teipa xijtilana para tiquijcuenis cursor huan titlaixkopinas. Sempa xijpacho para ayocmo titlaixkopinas. Cati hueli tijpatas para pincel huan rayas mocahua ipan ‘Xitlaixkopina’, campa titlaixkopina. ‘Xiquita → Campa más hueyi nesi cati titlaixkopina’ quicahua ma nesi más hueyi cursor o campa titlaixkopina, huan hueli tijpata quen hueyi nesi. ‘Quenicatza titlaixkopinas’ nojquiya quipiya cati quichihua ma nesi más alaxtic iteno pixels huan rayas. AN Paint quipiya seyoc once tlamantli letras; ipan ‘Licencias ten quen nesij letras’ tiquitas ajquiya quichijqui huan nochi cati tlanahuatíaj.

‘Amatl → Xijtapo ixkopinali’ quipata ixkopinali campa titlaixkopina ica campa Android mitzcahuilía xijtapejpeni. ‘Xitlaixkopina → Xijtali → Sequinoc ixkopinali’ quipiya amatl ten dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan ‘Wikimedia Commons · Mapas para xijtemiti (Blank maps)…’. Xijtapejpeni se ixkopinali ten dispositivo o xijtapo campa nesi ixkopinali ipan internet huan xijpacho ‘Xijtequihui ni ixkopinali’ para tijtlalis huan ma mocahua tapejpenili iselti. Ipan ‘Amatl → Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit → Ajquiya quichijqui ixkopinali huan canque mocui’ mocahuaj enlaces canque hualajqui huan tajcuiloli ten licencia. Sinta ajsi RAM cati dispositivo hueli quitequihuía, ixkopinali motapo ica ihuexca cati achtohui. Sinta monequi, nesi ihuexca, quesqui pixels huan quesqui RAM monequis, para xijtapejpeni seyoc ihuexca ica pixels o por ciento. Hueli tijtapejpenía sinta tijcahuas quen eltoya ipatajca ica ihuejcapanca. Amatl cati achtohui amo mopata.

‘Amatl → Tequit campa mosentilia ixkopinali’ quitapo se lugar iselti para 20 ixkopinali o menos. Xijsentili pilixkopinali ica inintoca amatl o quema quipatac. Hueli tijtequi se ixkopinali o tiquintequi miyac san se huelta. ‘San se ipatajca’ o ‘San se ihuejcapanca’ quincahuaj nochi ixkopinali ica san se ipatajca o ihuejcapanca, pero sesen quicahua quen eltoya ipatajca ica ihuejcapanca. Xijtilana se pilixkopinali o se ixkopinali cati ya tijtlalij para mopepechoa ipan inejmat san se ipan iixco, o tlatzintla san se ipan iarraves. Campa hueli tijtlalía canque mero elis, xijtlali esquina iixco ipan iarraves ica pixels enteros cati pehua ipan 0; sequinoc mocahuaj canque eltoyaj huan hueli mocahua se ipan seyoc. Cati tijtlalía teipa nesi ipan cati tijtlalij achtohui. Quema tiquijcuenía, san ixkopinali cati tijtapejpenijtoc mocuepa tlatzintla. Sequinoc mocahuaj canque eltoyaj; cati mopepechojtoque huelis moijcuenise para quitemitise canque polihui. ‘Ma nochi nesi’ quipata quen hueyi nesi. ‘Xicajocui PNG’ quiquixtía ixkopinali sentili. ‘Xijpata ipan Paint’ quihuica campa titequiti para tijpatas huan hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya. AN Paint quipiya san se campa titlaixkopina, campa amo hueli tiquita cati eltoc iica. Tequit campa mosentilia ixkopinali eltoc iselti.

Ipan panel ‘Amatl → Tajcuiloli ten AN Paint, licencias huan ajquiya quichijqui ni tequit’ onca derechos de autor cati achtohui, ajquiya quichijqui cati motequihuía huan tlamantli letras, nochi tajcuiloli ten licencia huan nochi código fuente ten ni versión. Hueli tijtilana tajcuiloli ten licencia; amo moijcuenía botones para tijchihuas copia ten nochi, tiquitas seyoc tlanahuatili o tijtlamiltis.

nhw/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.

nhw/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
nhw/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.previous:
Hueli tijtlalis hasta 20 tlaixkopintli ica campa tijtlapejpenía amatl ipan Android. Tlatzintla nesi tlaixkopintli piltziquitetzi, itoca sesen amatl, huan ihuexca sesen tlaixkopintli teipa quema tijcahua san se parte o tijtequihuía «San se ipatlajca» o «San se ihuejcapanca». Nojquiya nesi quema mopatlajqui sesen amatl, sintla catli quitemaca amatl quiijtohua. Xijtlali ipan orden ica itoca amatl o quema mopatlajqui. Ni orden amo quipatla campa ya motlalijtoc tlaixkopintli.

Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan se tlaixkopintli piltziquitetzi para tijtlapejpenis. «Xijcahua san se parte tlen tlaixkopintli» quipatla san nopa tlaixkopintli. «Xijcahua san se parte ipan miyac tlaixkopintli» quitequihuía pixels o por ciento ipan iteno tlaixkopintli catli tijtlapejpenijtoc. Xijtilana catli hueli tijquitzquis o xiquijcuilo quesqui tijquixtis. «Xijcahua nochi tlaixkopintli» sempa quinextía iteno catli achtihui. Amo mopatla amatl catli achtihui, huan hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya.

Xijcahua momajpil se tlatoctzi ipan se tlaixkopintli piltziquitetzi o xijtilana se tlaixkopintli catli ya eltoc campa titequiti; teipa xicahua ipan iteno catli AN Paint quinextía. Catli nesi achtihui, campa achi nesi catli eltoc iica, quinextía melahuac quen mocahuas. Ipan inejmac, ma monamicti iteno huejcapa; tlatzintla, ma monamicti iteno iopoch. Nojquiya hueli xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan se tlaixkopintli piltziquitetzi huan teipa ipan +. Quema mosentilia, nopa achtihui tlaixkopintli pehua ipan (0, 0). Sintla tijcahua san se parte tlen se tlaixkopintli, huelis mopatla campa eltoc tlaixkopintli catli mosentilijtoc ica ya. Quema mosentilia ica ni tequitl amo hueli se tlaixkopintli mocahuas iixpan seyoc.

Xijtlapejpeni se tlaixkopintli huan xijtequihui «Campa tijnequi xijtlali» para tijtlalis X huan Y tlen nopa esquina huejcapa ipan iopoch, ica pixels enteros tlen cero. Sequinok tlaixkopintli mocahua campa eltoc, huan hueli se tlaixkopintli mocahuas iixpan seyoc.

«San se ipatlajca» huan «San se ihuejcapanca» quichihua ma nochi tlaixkopintli quipiya san se ipatlajca o ihuejcapanca. Ipan sesen tlaixkopintli amo mopatla quen ihuejcapanca monamiqui ipatlajca. Xijtlapejpeni pixels, por ciento, «Catli más piltziquitetzi» o «Catli más hueyi». «Sempa xijtlali ihuexca catli achtihui» sempa quitlalía ihuexca sesen tlaixkopintli, pero amo quipatla nopa parte catli tijcajqui.

«Xijquixti campa motlalijtoc» sempa quihuica tlatzintla san nopa tlaixkopintli catli tijtlapejpenijtoc. Sequinok mocahua campa eltoc; nopa tlaixkopintli catli mosentilijtoc huelis mopatla campa eltoc para quitemitis campa mocajqui. «Xijquixti» quiquixtía san nopa tlaixkopintli tlen ni tequitl. «Sempa xijcahua quen eltoya» huan «Sempa xijchihua» sempa quitlalía ni cambios. Xijtilana tlaixkopintli catli motlalijtoc para tijpatlas campa eltoc; xijtilana campa amo onca tlaixkopintli para tijpatlas campa tiquita. Ica ome momajpil xijnechco o xijiyocatlali para tijpatlas quen hueyi nesi. «Show all» quipatla quen hueyi nesi para tiquitas nochi ni tequitl; amo quipatla ihuexca tlaixkopintli catli quisas.

«Xicajocui PNG» quiajocui nimantzi tlaixkopintli catli AN Paint quisentilijqui. «Xijpatla ipan Paint» quihuica ipan campa titlaixcopina para quipatlas tlaixkopintli catli eltoya; hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya. Sintla monequi más RAM que catli AN Paint quicahuilía, xijtlapejpeni se tlaixkopintli catli más piltziquitetzi sintla nesi nopa opción. Sintla hasta se tlaixkopintli nelía piltziquitetzi monequi más RAM, AN Paint quinextía tlajcuiloli tlen RAM huan amo ma tijtlapejpeni ihuexca. Amo mopatla amatl catli achtihui. AN Paint quiajocui ni tequitl ipan ni Android huan sempa quitlapos quema timocuepas.

Ni tequitl quitequihuía san se Catrobat/AGPL huan tlajcuiloli catli quiijtohua ajqueya quichijqui catli nesi ipan «Amatl > Tlajcuiloli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan ajqueya quichijqui ni tequitl» campa titlaixcopina.

nhw/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_be.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.
