Tlapalchiwali quipiya Lápiz, pincel, tlaixcopinali ica tlapali huan atl, huan tlaixcopinali ica ajacatl. Selection quipiya rectángulo huan catli titlaixcopina ica momajpil. Insert quipiya tlahuazantli, tlamantli quen nesi huan tlajkuiloli. Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan se categoría para tijtequihuis catli achtihui tijtequihui huan tiquitas catli hueli tijpatlas, tlatzintla quema pantalla eltoc huejcapantic, o ipan inejmac quema patlahuac. Sempa xijchihua ipan categoría catli tijtlapejpenijtoc para tijtzacuas o tijtlapos catli hueli tijtequihuis huan tijpatlas. Ipan sesen categoría mocahua catli sanoc tijtequihui hasta quema tiquisas. Xijtilana panel para tiquitas más. Huejcapa nesi itoca amatl huan catli hueli nimantzi tijchihuas. Ajqueya quichijqui huan condiciones: «Amatl > Tlajcuiloli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan ajqueya quichijqui ni tequitl».

Color quipiya machiotl tlen tlapali iixpan huan iica, «Xijpatla iixpan huan iica», «Sempa xijtequihui yayahuic / chipahuac» huan Advanced. Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan iixpan o iica tlen machiotl para tijpatlas nopa tlapali. Tlatzintla campa nesi itoca amatl eltoc tlapali catli onca sempa huan motlapali catli ticajoctoc. Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan se tlapali para iixpan; xijcahua momajpil se tlatoctzi para iica. Nahui lugares ipan inejmac campa eltoc tlapali catli onca sempa quiajocui tlapali catli sanoc tijtequihui; xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil para iixpan o xijcahua se tlatoctzi para iica. Campa tijpatla tlapali quipiya Palette, Panal huan Advanced. Advanced quipiya espectro, rueda, RGB, HSV, HSL huan hex ica chicuasen dígitos. Motlapali pehua ica Morado achi chipahuac #5B67FF, Oro #FFD700, Plata #C0C0C0 huan Cobre #B87333. Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan motlapali para iixpan; xijcahua se tlatoctzi para iica, para tijpatlas o para tijquixtis. Add colour o se lugar catli amo quipiya tlapali quitlapoa campa hueli ticajocuis tlapali. Tlaixkopintli campa titlaixcopina amo quicahuilía ma nesi catli eltoc iica. Sintla tijtlapoa tlaixkopintli catli quicahuilía ma nesi catli eltoc iica para campa titlaixcopina, campa quej nopa mocahua ica tlapali catli mocahua iica amantzi. Se tlaixkopintli catli tijtlalijqui mocahua tlapejpentoc iyoca; campa quicahuilía ma nesi catli eltoc iica, nesis nopa tlaixkopintli catli ya eltoc quema tijtlalijtoc. Tlaixkopintli tlen Wikimedia Commons quipiya chipahuac iica achtihui que tijtlalis. Amo mopatla amatl catli achtihui.

View > Navigate: xijtilana ica se momajpil para tijpatlas campa tiquita; xijnechco o xijiyocatlali ome momajpil para tijpatlas quen hueyi nesi huan xijtilana nochi ome para tijpatlas campa tiquita. Xijtlapejpeni Draw again ipan Navigate o se catli ica titlaixcopina para sempa titlaixcopinas. Hueli tijtequihuis ome momajpil ica catli ica titlaixcopina sin tijtlalis tlapali. Tlatzintla ipan inejmac eltoc se control ica se tlahuazantli itlajco ipan 100%. Botones para ma nesi más hueyi o más piltziquitetzi mocahua ipan 100% sintla se huelta quipanos; sempa xijtequihui para panos. Fit inechca quichihua ma nesi nochi campa titlaixcopina huan catli tlapejpentoc iyoca itlajco pantalla. Navigate nojquiya quipiya 100%; View quipiya «Inepamitl sesen pixel».

AN Paint quiajocui iseltzi catli tijchijqui se tlatoctzi teipa quema timocahua, huan quema tiquisa tlen app. Nesi sintla AN Paint quiajoctoc catli tijchijqui o amo huelqui quiajocuis iseltzi. Quema sempa tijtlapoa app, sempa nesi catli quiajoctoc iseltzi, itoca amatl, catli tijtlapejpenijtoc para titequitis, catli tlapejpentoc iyoca huan tlamantli catli ayamo tlamía. Autosave quiajocui iyoca catli tijchijqui. Amatl quipiya PNG, JPEG huan HEIC campa hueli tijpatla calidad, huan JPEG XL, WebP huan AVIF ica o sin quicahuas catli nesi. «Xicajocui…» quitlapejpenía formato, catli hueli mopatla huan campa quiajocuis; «Xicajocui» sempa quiajocui nopaya. Export as huan «Xicajocui huan xijtitlani» quiajocui seyoc tlaixkopintli sin quipatlas campa quiajocui «Xicajocui» huan sin quiijtos tlaixkopintli ya mocajocui. «Xicajocui huan xijtitlani» teipa quitlapoa campa Android quititlanía. Sitlali inechca itoca quiijtohua ayamo mocajocui nochi catli tijchijqui. AN Paint amo quipatla tlaixkopintli catli achtihui quema quiajocui iseltzi.

Selection: xitlaixcopina se rectángulo o inepamitl ica momajpil. Xijtilana itic para tijtilanas, xijtilana cuadrado ipan esquina o itlajco se iteno para tijpatlas ihuexca o xijtilana círculo «Xijyahualo» para tijyahualos. «Amo xijpatla quen ihuejcapanca monamiqui ipatlajca» pehua tequiti; xijcahua ma ayocmo tequiti para huelis tijpatlas ipatlajca huan ihuejcapanca iyoca. Catli tijquitzquía ipan iteno quipatla ihuexca ipan nopa lado catli tijtlapejpenijtoc. Catli titlaixcopinac ica momajpil quicahua quen tiquixcopinac itic nopa rectángulo campa tijpatla, hasta teipa quema tijyahualo o AN Paint quiajocui iseltzi. Ihuexca huan ángulo nesi ipan panel. «Xijtlali catli tijtlapejpenijtoc ipan tlaixkopintli» quitlalía catli tijpatlac; hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya, huan AN Paint quiajocui iseltzi hasta catli ayamo tlamis. Copy, «Xijtequi» huan «Xijcahua san catli tijtlapejpenijtoc» quitequihuía ni tlaixkopintli catli tijpatlac. Select all eltoc ipan Edit > Selection, huan tequiti Ctrl+A ipan teclado. «Xijtequi», Copy huan Paste nesi huejcapa para nimantzi tijtequihuis. Catli tijtlapejpenijtoc mocahua san quen tiquixcopinac; campa titlaixcopina amo quicahuilía ma nesi catli eltoc iica.

Inepamitl campa titlaixcopina: xijtilana catli hueli tijquitzquis ipan itic para tijtequis, o caltenco para tijhueyilis ipan sesen iteno; teipa xijtequihui Apply bounds. Campa yancuic quipiya tlapali catli mocahua iica. Amo mopatla ihuexca pixels catli ya eltoc. Hueli xijcahua o sempa xijcahua quen eltoya. «Xijpatla ihuexca tlaixkopintli», «Ihuexca campa titlaixcopina» huan «Yankuik tlaixkopintli» hueli quitequihuis pixels o por ciento, huan hueli quicahuas amo ma mopatla quen ihuejcapanca monamiqui ipatlajca.

Tlahuazantli (curva): xitlaixcopina se tlahuazantli huan xijtilana ome huelta para mocuelpachos. Polígono: xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan sesen esquina, huan ipan catli tlamía xijchihua ome huelta nimantzi, o xijtequihui «Xijtlamilti ni polígono». Ayocmo xijtequihui «Xijtzacua iteno (polígono)» para titlaixcopinas tlahuazantli catli mosentilia pero amo motzacua. Rectángulo ica esquinas yahualtic: xijtlali radio (px) ica icontrol; amo hueli quipanos tlajco tlen iteno catli más pilquentzi. Tlajkuiloli: xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil campa titlaixcopina, xijtlapejpeni quen nesi tlajkuiloli (sesen tlamantli nesi quen ijcuilihui) huan xiquita quen mopatla. Hueli tijpatlas ihuexca, bold, cursiva, tlahuazantli itzintla o itlajco, campa monamiqui, quen huejca eltoc sesen tlajcuilolpamitl huan tlapali catli mocahua iica. Xitlaixcopina quen ica tlapali huan atl eltoc ipan Tlapalchiwali inechca pincel huan catli tequiti ica ajacatl; xijpatla quen chicahuac nesi tlapali para ma nesi más yamanic. Controles tlen Lápiz, pincel huan ihuexca catli ica titequiti hasta 100 pixels. Lápiz pehua ica 1 pixel huan quiajocui ipatlajca iyoca. Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan nopa número catli nesi para tiquijcuilos número catli melahuac tijnequi. Yolo, Sitlali huan Mitl quipiya san se opciones tlen Iteno huan Nochi itic ica se tlapali quej sequinok formas. View > Quen titlaixcopinas ica cursor quinextía campa hueli tijchihuas ma tequiti, quen nesi machiotl huan campa más hueyi nesi. Xijtilana para tijtlalis cursor, xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan botón para titlaixcopinas, huan teipa xijtilana para tijtilanas cursor huan titlaixcopinas. Sempa xijchihua ipan botón para tlamis. Pincel huan tlahuazantli mocahua ipan Draw > Tlapalchiwali. View > Campa más hueyi nesi catli titlaixcopina quichihua ma más hueyi nesi campa eltoc cursor o campa titlaixcopina, huan hueli tijpatlas quen hueyi nesi. Opciones tlen Tlapalchiwali nojquiya quipiya catli quichihua ma nesi más alaxtic inepamitl sesen pixel huan catli titlaixcopina ica momajpil. Onca majtlactli huan se seyoc tlamantli tlajkuiloli. Licencias tlen tlamantli tlajkuiloli quipiya ajqueya quichijqui huan nochi condiciones.

Amatl > Xijtlapo tlaixkopintli quipatla tlaixkopintli campa titlaixcopina ica catli tijtlapejpenía ipan Android. «Draw → Insert → Sekinok tlaixkopintli» quipiya amatl tlen Android, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapas catli amo quipiya itoca campa nesi…». Xijtlapejpeni tlaixkopintli tlen Android, o xijtlapo página tlen yekchiwalisyotl ipan internet huan xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan «Xijtequihui ni tlaixkopintli» para tijtlalis tlapejpentoc iyoca. «Amatl > Tlajcuiloli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan ajqueya quichijqui ni tequitl > Ajqueya quichijqui tlaixkopintli o canque hualajqui» quiajocui enlaces tlen campa hualajqui huan aviso tlen licencia. Tlaixkopintli catli amo monequi más RAM que catli Android hueli quitequihuis motlapoa ica ihuexca catli achtihui. Sintla monequi, nesi campa tijtlapejpenía ihuexca, quesqui pixels huan quesqui RAM AN Paint quipohua monequis; hueli xijtlapejpeni pixels o por ciento huan xijcahua amo ma mopatla quen ihuejcapanca monamiqui ipatlajca. Amo mopatla amatl catli achtihui.

«Amatl» > «Tequitl campa mosentilia tlaixkopintli» quitlapoa se lugar iyoca para hasta 20 tlaixkopintli. Xijtlali ipan orden ica itoca amatl o quema mopatlajqui. Xijcahua san se parte tlen se tlaixkopintli, o ipan miyac tlaixkopintli. «San se ipatlajca» o «San se ihuejcapanca» quipatla ihuexca nochi, pero amo quipatla quen ihuejcapanca monamiqui ipatlajca ipan sesen tlaixkopintli. Xijtilana tlaixkopintli piltziquitetzi o catli motlalijtoc para mosentilis ipan inejmac san se iteno huejcapa, o tlatzintla san se iteno iopoch. «Campa tijnequi xijtlali» quitlalía nopa esquina huejcapa ipan iopoch ica pixels enteros tlen cero, amo quipatla campa eltoc sequinok tlaixkopintli huan quicahuilía se tlaixkopintli mocahuas iixpan seyoc. Tlaixkopintli catli teipa tijtlalis nesi iixpan. «Xijquixti campa motlalijtoc» quiquixtía san nopa tlaixkopintli catli tijtlapejpenijtoc tlen campa motlalijtoc. Sequinok mocahua campa eltoc; catli mosentilijtoc huelis mopatla campa eltoc para quitemitis campa mocajqui. «Show all» quipatla quen hueyi nesi. «Xicajocui PNG» quiajocui tlaixkopintli catli AN Paint quisentilijqui; «Xijpatla ipan Paint» quihuica campa titlaixcopina quen se cambio catli hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya. AN Paint quipiya san se campa titlaixcopina catli amo quicahuilía ma nesi catli eltoc iica. Tequitl campa mosentilia tlaixkopintli eltoc iyoca.

Panel «Amatl > Tlajcuiloli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan ajqueya quichijqui ni tequitl» quipiya chijchijketl ixkayotl catli achtihui, tlajcuiloli tlen ajqueya quichijqui tlamantli huan tlajkuiloli, nochi tlajcuiloli tlen licencia huan nochi código fuente tlen ni versión. Hueli xijtilana tlajcuiloli tlen licencia iyoca, pero amo moojolinía nopa botones Copy all, «Sekinok condiciones» huan Done.

Tlajkuiloli: xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil campa titlaixcopina, xijtlapejpeni quen nesi tlajkuiloli (sesen tlamantli nesi quen ijcuilihui) huan xiquita quen mopatla. Hueli tijpatlas ihuexca, bold, cursiva, tlahuazantli itzintla o itlajco, campa monamiqui, quen huejca eltoc sesen tlajcuilolpamitl huan tlapali catli mocahua iica. Xitlaixcopina quen ica tlapali huan atl eltoc ipan Tlapalchiwali inechca pincel huan catli tequiti ica ajacatl; xijpatla quen chicahuac nesi tlapali para ma nesi más yamanic. Controles tlen Lápiz, pincel huan ihuexca catli ica titequiti hasta 100 pixels. Lápiz pehua ica 1 pixel huan quiajocui ipatlajca iyoca. Xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan nopa número catli nesi para tiquijcuilos número catli melahuac tijnequi. Yolo, Sitlali huan Mitl quipiya san se opciones tlen Iteno huan Nochi itic ica se tlapali quej sequinok formas. «Xiquita» > Quen titlaixcopinas ica cursor quinextía campa hueli tijchihuas ma tequiti, quen nesi machiotl huan campa más hueyi nesi. Xijtilana para tijtlalis cursor, xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan botón para titlaixcopinas, huan teipa xijtilana para tijtilanas cursor huan titlaixcopinas. Sempa xijchihua ipan botón para tlamis. Pincel huan tlahuazantli mocahua ipan «Xitlaixcopina» > Tlapalchiwali. «Xiquita» > Campa más hueyi nesi catli titlaixcopina quichihua ma más hueyi nesi campa eltoc cursor o campa titlaixcopina, huan hueli tijpatlas quen hueyi nesi. Opciones tlen Tlapalchiwali nojquiya quipiya catli quichihua ma nesi más alaxtic inepamitl sesen pixel huan catli titlaixcopina ica momajpil. Onca majtlactli huan se seyoc tlamantli tlajkuiloli. Licencias tlen tlamantli tlajkuiloli quipiya ajqueya quichijqui huan nochi condiciones.

Amatl > Xijtlapo tlaixkopintli quipatla tlaixkopintli campa titlaixcopina ica catli tijtlapejpenía ipan Android. «Xitlaixcopina → Xijtlali → Sekinok tlaixkopintli» quipiya amatl tlen Android, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapas para xijtemiti (Blank maps)…». Xijtlapejpeni tlaixkopintli tlen Android, o xijtlapo página tlen yekchiwalisyotl ipan internet huan xijtlali huan nimantzi xijquixti momajpil ipan «Xijtequihui ni tlaixkopintli» para tijtlalis tlapejpentoc iyoca. «Amatl > Tlajcuiloli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan ajqueya quichijqui ni tequitl > Ajqueya quichijqui tlaixkopintli, canque hualajqui huan licencia» quiajocui enlaces tlen campa hualajqui huan aviso tlen licencia. Tlaixkopintli catli amo monequi más RAM que catli Android hueli quitequihuis motlapoa ica ihuexca catli achtihui. Sintla monequi, nesi campa tijtlapejpenía ihuexca, quesqui pixels huan quesqui RAM AN Paint quipohua monequis; hueli xijtlapejpeni pixels o por ciento huan xijcahua amo ma mopatla quen ihuejcapanca monamiqui ipatlajca. Amo mopatla amatl catli achtihui.

«Amatl» > «Tequitl campa mosentilia tlaixkopintli» quitlapoa se lugar iyoca para hasta 20 tlaixkopintli. Xijtlali ipan orden ica itoca amatl o quema mopatlajqui. Xijcahua san se parte tlen se tlaixkopintli, o ipan miyac tlaixkopintli. «San se ipatlajca» o «San se ihuejcapanca» quipatla ihuexca nochi, pero amo quipatla quen ihuejcapanca monamiqui ipatlajca ipan sesen tlaixkopintli. Xijtilana tlaixkopintli piltziquitetzi o catli motlalijtoc para mosentilis ipan inejmac san se iteno huejcapa, o tlatzintla san se iteno iopoch. «Campa tijnequi xijtlali» quitlalía nopa esquina huejcapa ipan iopoch ica pixels enteros tlen cero, amo quipatla campa eltoc sequinok tlaixkopintli huan quicahuilía se tlaixkopintli mocahuas iixpan seyoc. Tlaixkopintli catli teipa tijtlalis nesi iixpan. «Xijquixti campa motlalijtoc» quiquixtía san nopa tlaixkopintli catli tijtlapejpenijtoc tlen campa motlalijtoc. Sequinok mocahua campa eltoc; catli mosentilijtoc huelis mopatla campa eltoc para quitemitis campa mocajqui. «Xijnexti nochi» quipatla quen hueyi nesi. «Xicajocui PNG» quiajocui tlaixkopintli catli AN Paint quisentilijqui; «Xijpatla ipan Paint» quihuica campa titlaixcopina quen se cambio catli hueli sempa tijcahuas quen eltoya. AN Paint quipiya san se campa titlaixcopina catli amo quicahuilía ma nesi catli eltoc iica. Tequitl campa mosentilia tlaixkopintli eltoc iyoca.

Panel «Amatl > Tlajcuiloli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan ajqueya quichijqui ni tequitl» quipiya chijchijketl ixkayotl catli achtihui, tlajcuiloli tlen ajqueya quichijqui tlamantli huan tlajkuiloli, nochi tlajcuiloli tlen licencia huan nochi código fuente tlen ni versión. Hueli xijtilana tlajcuiloli tlen licencia iyoca, pero amo moojolinía nopa botones Copy all, «Sekinok condiciones» huan Done.

tdd/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
tdd/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.previous:
ᥗᥦᥛᥴ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥗᥪᥒᥴ 20 ᥟᥢ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥖᥨᥝ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ Android. ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥖᥬᥲ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥨᥒ ᥘᥣᥲ, ᥓᥪ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ, ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥕᥝᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ, ᥘᥦᥰ ᥕᥣᥛᥰ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥙᥩᥴ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥙᥢ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥙᥢ ᥛᥣᥰ. ᥖᥒᥲ ᥘᥣᥭᥰ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥓᥪ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥕᥣᥛᥰ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭ; ᥟᥛᥱ ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥕᥝᥳ.

ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥨᥒ ᥘᥣᥲ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥫᥐ. «ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ» ᥖᥖᥴ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥢᥳ; «ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥘᥣᥭᥴ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥓᥨᥛᥰ ᥐᥢ» ᥓᥬᥳ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥖᥖᥴ ᥙᥥᥢ px ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥙᥧᥢ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ. ᥘᥣᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥛᥰ ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥙᥨᥝᥳ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ. «ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥙᥫᥒ ᥐᥥᥝ» ᥝᥭᥳ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ. ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥞᥥᥖᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ ᥘᥧᥳ, ᥑᥪᥢᥴ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥘᥭᥲ.

ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥨᥒ ᥘᥣᥲ ᥝᥭᥳ, ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥘᥣᥐ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥕᥧᥱ ᥘᥬᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ, ᥔᥥᥴ ᥙᥩᥭᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥔᥦᥒᥴ. ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥝᥨᥒ ᥘᥣᥲ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥒᥴ ᥘᥭᥲ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥙᥫᥒ ᥖᥩᥱ ᥖᥥᥳ. ᥖᥩᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥑᥣᥴ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥖᥣᥝᥱ ᥐᥢ; ᥖᥩᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥖᥬᥲ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥔᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥣᥝᥱ ᥐᥢ. ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥨᥒ ᥘᥣᥲ, ᥔᥥᥴ ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥛᥣᥭᥴ + ᥐᥩᥲ ᥘᥭᥲ. ᥛᥫ ᥖᥩᥱ, ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥐᥩᥢᥱ ᥖᥥᥱ ᥖᥤ 0, 0. ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥖᥩᥱ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥟᥣᥙ ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥛᥫ ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥛᥢᥰ ᥖᥩᥱ ᥖᥤ. ᥛᥫ ᥖᥩᥱ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥗᥩᥙ ᥐᥢ.

«ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ» ᥘᥦᥰ «ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ» ᥞᥬᥲ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥐᥧ ᥟᥢ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥒᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ, ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ : ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥛᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ. ᥘᥫᥐ px, ᥙᥧᥢ, «ᥟᥦᥖᥴ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥙᥫᥢ» ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ «ᥕᥬᥱ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥙᥫᥢ». «ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ» ᥛᥩᥖᥱ ᥙᥦᥖ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥝᥭᥳ.

«ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ» ᥘᥦᥰ «ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ» ᥞᥬᥲ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥐᥧ ᥟᥢ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥒᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ, ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ : ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥛᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ. ᥘᥫᥐ px, ᥙᥧᥢ, «ᥟᥦᥖᥴ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥙᥫᥢ» ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ «ᥕᥬᥱ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥙᥫᥢ». «ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ» ᥛᥩᥖᥱ ᥙᥦᥖ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥝᥭᥳ.

«ᥟᥝ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥘᥧᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ» ᥟᥝ ᥐᥣᥲ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ. ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥕᥒᥰ ᥕᥧᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥭᥳ; ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥖᥩᥱ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥟᥣᥙ ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥖᥥᥛ ᥖᥤ ᥙᥝᥱ. «ᥛᥩᥖᥱ ᥙᥦᥖ» (ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥘᥧᥐ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ) ᥛᥩᥖᥱ ᥐᥣᥲ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥢᥳ. ᥑᥪᥢᥴ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ / ᥞᥥᥖᥱ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥘᥩᥒ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭ ᥓᥫᥰ ᥘᥢᥳ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ. ᥘᥣᥐ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ; ᥘᥣᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥙᥝᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ. ᥕᥐᥴ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥴ. «ᥘᥥᥴ ᥛᥨᥖᥴ» ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥖᥒᥰ ᥛᥨᥖᥴ, ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ.

«ᥔᥤᥛᥰ PNG» ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥐᥛᥰ ᥘᥫᥝᥰ. «ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥘᥬᥰ Paint» ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥑᥝᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥓᥧᥙᥰ ᥕᥬᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ, ᥑᥪᥢᥴ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥘᥭᥲ. ᥙᥩᥴ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥙᥨᥢᥳ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥘᥩᥒ ᥛᥐᥴ ᥑᥣᥢᥰ RAM, ᥘᥫᥐ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥗᥧᥖ ᥟᥝ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥙᥩᥴ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥘᥫᥐ. ᥙᥩᥴ ᥗᥪᥒᥴ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥘᥣᥱ ᥙᥨᥢᥳ ᥘᥫᥴ, AN Paint ᥘᥥᥴ ᥘᥤᥐ ᥙᥩᥐᥱ ᥘᥩᥒ RAM ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥖᥤ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ. ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥕᥣᥛᥰ ᥘᥥᥝ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥘᥬᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥭᥱ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥛᥫ ᥑᥪᥢᥴ ᥛᥣᥰ.

ᥙᥫᥒ ᥞᥥᥖᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥭᥳ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥧᥢᥰ ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ Catrobat/AGPL ᥘᥦᥰ ᥔᥤᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ ᥖᥒᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥘᥬᥰ «ᥜᥣᥭᥱ > ᥘᥩᥒ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ AN Paint, ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ» ᥘᥬᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥓᥧᥙᥰ ᥕᥬᥱ.
tdd/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.reason: Checked the pinned crop, reset, unit, dimension, exact-position, Unplace and output captions; specifically scopes Remove to the assembly rather than the original file.

tdd/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
tdd/ui_help23.previous: ᥘᥫᥐ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥘᥢᥳ. ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥖᥥᥱ ᥘᥒᥱ «ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ»; ᥑᥣᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥑᥣᥱ, ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ. ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥑᥣᥱ; ᥕᥐᥴ ᥘᥥᥝᥳ ᥛᥪᥰ 2 ᥘᥥᥝᥳ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥴ. ᥘᥦᥛᥲ ᥙᥧᥢ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥭᥲ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥖᥨᥙ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥝᥭᥳ. ᥑᥫᥒ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥐᥧ ᥟᥢ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥓᥪ. ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ, ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ, ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ. ᥔᥤᥴ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥣᥲ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥒᥴ; «ᥘᥦᥐ ᥐᥢ ᥔᥤᥴ» ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥩᥒᥴ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥐᥢ ᥘᥦᥰ «ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥘᥛ / ᥔᥤᥴ ᥑᥣᥝᥴ» ᥝᥭᥳ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥙᥥᥢ ᥘᥛ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥑᥣᥝᥴ. ᥖᥨᥝ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥐᥛᥰ ᥘᥫᥝᥰ. «ᥓᥬᥳ ᥔᥤᥴ» ᥛᥐᥴ ᥛᥢᥲ ᥔᥤᥴ; «ᥟᥛᥱ ᥞᥥᥖᥱ» ᥝᥭᥳ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥐᥝᥱ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ. ᥓᥬᥳ «ᥗᥦᥛᥴ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥔᥤᥴ» ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥙᥝᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥔᥤᥴ. ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥟᥢ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥛᥩᥖᥱ ᥙᥦᥖ. «ᥓᥢᥳ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ» ᥖᥤ ᥐᥭᥲ ᥘᥛ / ᥑᥣᥝᥴ ᥚᥧᥭᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥘᥦᥒᥰ ᥘᥣᥭᥴ. ᥔᥤᥳ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ px ᥘᥥᥴ ᥛᥣᥭᥴ ᥟᥣᥢᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥙᥥᥢ px ᥞᥒᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥐᥩᥲ; ᥑᥣᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥛᥣᥭᥴ ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥘᥥᥴ x/y ᥕᥣᥛᥰ ᥘᥥᥝ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥭᥲ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥘᥥᥴ. «ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥙᥥᥢ…» ᥘᥫᥐ ᥛᥥᥝᥰ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ, ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥞᥥᥖᥱ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥘᥨᥒᥰ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ; «ᥔᥤᥛᥰ» ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥘᥢᥳ ᥗᥦᥢᥲ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥓᥫᥰ ᥘᥢᥳ. «ᥔᥨᥒᥱ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥙᥥᥢ…» ᥔᥣᥒᥲ ICO, ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ASCII ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥘᥤᥐ Base64 ᥘᥒᥱ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥛᥣᥭᥴ ᥝᥣ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥕᥝᥳ. «ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥔᥨᥒᥱ ᥙᥢ» ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥗᥧᥖ ᥟᥝ, ᥔᥥᥴ ᥚᥧᥭᥱ ᥙᥫᥒ ᥔᥨᥒᥱ ᥙᥢ ᥞᥒᥰ Android. ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥕᥣᥛᥰ ᥘᥥᥝ. ᥑᥣᥱ > ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ > ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥬᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart ᥘᥦᥰ «Wikimedia Commons · ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥚᥦᥢᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥙᥝᥱ…». ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥕᥒᥰ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ; ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥛᥰ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥛᥢᥰ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥝᥣ ᥕᥧᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥢᥩᥐᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥑᥣᥱ. «ᥞᥬᥲ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥒᥛᥱ» ᥘᥦᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ; «ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ» ᥝᥭᥳ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥒᥣᥱ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ. ᥛᥫ ᥚᥧᥭᥱ AN Paint ᥑᥪᥢᥰ, ᥐᥣᥢ ᥔᥤᥛᥰ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥖᥨᥝ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭᥰ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥞᥥᥖᥱ ᥙᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥣᥰ ᥖᥣᥱ «ᥑᥪᥢᥴ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ» ᥘᥦᥰ «ᥞᥥᥖᥱ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ» ᥖᥒᥰ ᥔᥩᥒᥴ ᥟᥢ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ. ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ, ᥘᥣᥭᥰ ᥓᥬᥳ AN Paint ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥩᥒ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ AN Paint, ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ ᥐᥩᥲ. ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥘᥤᥐ ᥖᥦᥛᥲ ᥙᥣᥭ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥘᥨᥒᥰ ᥘᥭᥲ.

tdd/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_be.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.

ᥘᥫᥐ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ, ᥑᥣᥱ, ᥜᥣᥭᥱ, ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥔᥤᥴ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥘᥢᥳ. ᥘᥦᥛᥲ ᥙᥧᥢ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥭᥲ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥖᥨᥙ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥥᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ. ᥛᥫ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ, ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥢᥤᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥙᥣᥭ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ; ᥘᥣᥐ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥗᥦᥛᥴ. ᥛᥫ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ, ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥓᥧᥙᥰ ᥕᥬᥱ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥘᥨᥒᥰ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥔᥣᥭᥳ. ᥑᥣᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥑᥣᥱ, ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥔᥦᥢ ᥙᥤᥲ, ᥙᥤᥲ ᥑᥨᥢᥴ, Watercolor ᥘᥦᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥤᥴ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥞᥣᥒᥲ 4 ᥓᥩᥐ 90° ᥘᥦᥰ ᥞᥣᥒᥲ ᥟᥢ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥟᥝ. ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥔᥤᥳ, ᥞᥣᥒᥲ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥤᥐ. ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥟᥢ ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥖᥬᥲ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥛᥫ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ, ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥑᥣᥴ ᥛᥫ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ. ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥗᥦᥢᥲ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥖᥨᥙ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥥᥱ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥐᥧ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥟᥢ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥔᥧᥖᥴ ᥘᥬᥰ ᥕᥣᥛᥰ ᥓᥬᥳ AN Paint ᥙᥩᥐᥱ ᥘᥭᥳ. ᥘᥣᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥗᥦᥛᥴ. ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥓᥪ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥝᥭᥰ. ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥧᥢᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥐᥴ: «ᥜᥣᥭᥱ > ᥘᥩᥒ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ AN Paint, ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ».

ᥘᥫᥐ «ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ», «ᥑᥣᥱ», «ᥜᥣᥭᥱ», «ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ» ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ «ᥔᥤᥴ» ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥘᥢᥳ. ᥘᥦᥛᥲ ᥙᥧᥢ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥭᥲ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥖᥨᥙ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥥᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ. ᥛᥫ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ, ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥢᥤᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥙᥣᥭ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ; ᥘᥣᥐ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥗᥦᥛᥴ. ᥛᥫ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ, ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥐᥛᥳ ᥐᥦᥛ ᥓᥧᥙᥰ ᥕᥬᥱ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥘᥨᥒᥰ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥔᥣᥭᥳ. ᥑᥣᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥑᥣᥱ, ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥔᥦᥢ ᥙᥤᥲ, ᥙᥤᥲ ᥑᥨᥢᥴ, «ᥙᥤᥲ ᥑᥨᥢᥴ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥟᥩᥢᥱ (Watercolor)» ᥘᥦᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥤᥴ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥞᥣᥒᥲ 4 ᥓᥩᥐ 90° ᥘᥦᥰ ᥞᥣᥒᥲ ᥟᥢ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥟᥝ. ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥔᥤᥳ, ᥞᥣᥒᥲ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥤᥐ. ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥟᥢ ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥖᥬᥲ ᥗᥦᥝᥴ ᥛᥫ ᥖᥤ ᥚᥖᥴ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ, ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥑᥣᥴ ᥛᥫ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ. ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥗᥦᥢᥲ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥖᥨᥙ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥥᥱ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥐᥧ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥟᥢ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥔᥧᥖᥴ ᥘᥬᥰ ᥕᥣᥛᥰ ᥓᥬᥳ AN Paint ᥙᥩᥐᥱ ᥘᥭᥳ. ᥘᥣᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥖᥒᥲ ᥗᥦᥛᥴ. ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥛᥤᥰ ᥓᥪ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥖᥤ ᥖᥥᥐᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥝᥭᥰ. ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥧᥢᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥐᥴ: «ᥜᥣᥭᥱ > ᥘᥩᥒ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ AN Paint, ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ».

ᥜᥣᥭᥱ > ᥚᥧᥭᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥑᥣᥱ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥖᥨᥝ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ Android. «ᥑᥣᥱ → ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ → ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ» ᥛᥤᥰ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥬᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart ᥘᥦᥰ «Wikimedia Commons · ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥚᥦᥢᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥙᥝᥱ…». ᥘᥫᥐ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥬᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ, ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥧᥭᥱ ᥘᥣᥲ ᥘᥤᥐ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ online ᥔᥥᥴ ᥖᥥᥐᥱ «ᥓᥬᥳ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ» ᥖᥣᥱ ᥓᥤᥛ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥙᥥᥢ ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥙᥭᥱ ᥛᥐᥴ ᥛᥢᥲ. ᥜᥣᥭᥱ > ᥘᥩᥒ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ AN Paint, ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ > ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥧᥢᥰ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥒᥣᥱ, ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥩᥒ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥐᥥᥙᥱ URL ᥒᥝᥲ ᥒᥣᥱ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥤᥐ ᥙᥩᥐᥱ ᥛᥬ. ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥙᥨᥢᥳ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥘᥩᥒ ᥛᥐᥴ ᥑᥣᥢᥰ RAM ᥞᥒᥰ ᥑᥫᥒ ᥚᥧᥭᥱ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ. ᥙᥩᥴ ᥘᥨᥝᥱ, ᥖᥤ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ, ᥛᥣᥭᥴ ᥢᥙᥴ px ᥘᥦᥰ RAM ᥟᥣᥢᥰ ᥝᥣ ᥓᥬᥳ; ᥘᥫᥐ px/ᥙᥧᥢ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥘᥫᥐ ᥑᥖᥴ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ : ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥘᥭᥲ. ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭ.

«ᥜᥣᥭᥱ» > ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥚᥧᥭᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥞᥥᥖᥱ ᥐᥣᥢ ᥚᥥᥴ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥗᥪᥒᥴ 20 ᥟᥢ. ᥖᥒᥲ ᥘᥣᥭᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥨᥒ ᥘᥣᥲ ᥘᥒᥱ ᥓᥪ ᥜᥣᥭᥱ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥕᥣᥛᥰ. ᥖᥖᥴ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ 1 ᥟᥢ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥘᥣᥭᥴ ᥟᥢ ᥓᥨᥛᥰ ᥐᥢ. ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ / ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥛᥫᥢᥴ ᥐᥢ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥖᥒᥰ ᥛᥨᥖᥴ, ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥐᥣᥒᥲ : ᥖᥣᥒᥰ ᥔᥧᥒᥴ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥛᥢᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ. ᥘᥣᥐ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥘᥥᥐ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥨᥒ ᥘᥣᥲ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥕᥝᥳ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥖᥩᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥑᥣᥴ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥖᥣᥝᥱ ᥐᥢ, ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥢᥴ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥖᥬᥲ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥑᥩᥙᥱ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥔᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥣᥝᥱ ᥐᥢ. «ᥟᥩᥒᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥖᥥᥳ» ᥖᥒᥲ ᥓᥩᥐ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥴ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥔᥣᥭᥳ ᥙᥥᥢ px ᥖᥥᥛ ᥖᥥᥱ ᥘᥧᥐ 0, ᥐᥥᥙᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥗᥩᥙ ᥐᥢ ᥘᥭᥲ. ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥔᥬᥱ ᥑᥝᥲ ᥘᥒᥴ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥚᥣᥭᥱ ᥘᥫᥴ. «ᥟᥝ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥘᥧᥐ ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ» ᥟᥝ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ ᥐᥣᥲ ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥫᥐ. ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥖᥣᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥕᥒᥰ ᥝᥭᥳ; ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥖᥩᥱ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥟᥣᥙ ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥞᥬᥲ ᥖᥥᥛ ᥖᥤ ᥙᥝᥱ. «ᥘᥥᥴ ᥛᥨᥖᥴ» ᥘᥦᥐ ᥔᥦᥢᥰ ᥟᥢ ᥘᥥᥴ. «ᥔᥤᥛᥰ PNG» ᥔᥨᥒᥱ ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥟᥩᥐᥱ; «ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥘᥬᥰ Paint» ᥑᥣᥭᥳ ᥑᥝᥲ ᥙᥥᥢ ᥘᥩᥒ ᥘᥦᥐ ᥘᥣᥭ ᥟᥢ ᥑᥪᥢᥴ ᥑᥪᥢᥰ ᥘᥭᥲ. AN Paint ᥓᥬᥳ ᥖᥤ ᥛᥨᥢᥳ ᥛᥥᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ 1 ᥖᥤ ᥟᥢ ᥟᥛᥱ ᥘᥥᥴ ᥗᥣᥭᥱ ᥙᥨᥢᥳ. ᥓᥧᥛᥰ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥙᥥᥢ ᥖᥤ ᥝᥭᥳ ᥙᥧᥒᥱ ᥚᥥᥴ.

ᥖᥤ «ᥜᥣᥭᥱ > ᥘᥩᥒ ᥖᥣᥒᥰ AN Paint, ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥖᥣᥱ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ» ᥛᥤᥰ ᥔᥧᥢᥱ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ, ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥧᥢᥰ ᥚᥧᥱ ᥔᥣᥒᥲ ᥔᥤᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ ᥓᥬᥳ ᥘᥦᥰ ᥞᥣᥒᥲ ᥖᥨᥝ ᥘᥤᥐ, ᥘᥤᥐ ᥛᥬ ᥖᥒᥰ ᥛᥨᥖᥴ ᥘᥦᥰ code ᥒᥝᥲ ᥖᥪᥢᥰ ᥖᥒᥰ ᥛᥨᥖᥴ ᥞᥒᥰ ᥙᥫᥒ ᥘᥭᥳ. ᥘᥣᥐ ᥖᥨᥭᥰ ᥘᥤᥐ ᥛᥬ ᥚᥥᥴ ᥘᥭᥲ, ᥖᥤ ᥖᥥᥐᥱ «ᥗᥧᥖ ᥟᥝ ᥛᥨᥖᥴ», «ᥑᥨᥝᥲ ᥛᥐᥴ ᥖᥣᥒᥱ ᥟᥢ» ᥘᥦᥰ «ᥕᥝᥳ» ᥕᥒᥰ ᥕᥧᥱ ᥖᥤ ᥐᥥᥝ.

nv/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
nv/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.previous:
Android naaltsoos bikʼidiilnííh bee eʼelyaaígíí 20 jįʼ biiʼ hééł ánílééh. Bitłʼááh eʼelyaaígíí áłtsʼíísígíí, naaltsoos bizhiʼ, bibąąh aniłgéésh dóó niteelíjįʼgo/deigo ánízáád tʼáá íłʼíní ályaa bikʼijįʼ niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád, dóó naaltsoos łahgo ályaaígíí háádą́ą́ʼ (bee hazʼą́ągo) yishʼį́. Naaltsoos bizhiʼ doodago háádą́ą́ʼ łahgo ályaaígíí bikʼehgo ałnaa ánílééh; eʼelyaaígíí biiʼ hééł ályaaígíí doo náánáshood da.

Eʼelyaaígíí áłtsʼíísígíí bikʼidiilnííh biniiyé bił adílchííd. «Eʼelyaaígíí bibąąh aniłgéésh» éí eʼelyaaígíí tʼááłáʼí bibąąh aniłgéésh. «Eʼelyaaígíí bikʼidiilnííhígíí bibąąh aniłgéésh» bee éí eʼelyaaígíí bikʼidiilnííhígíí bibąąh (px doodago neeznádiinjįʼ ałtsʼájíniłgo) aniłgéésh. Bibąąh dichʼííʼígíí nanishood doodago ánéeltʼeʼ bikááʼ ánílééh. «Bibąąh aniłgéésh · Nináánídlé» bee bibąąh áłtséédą́ą́ʼ nináánídlé. Bibąąh aniłgééshgo áłtséédą́ą́ʼ naaltsoos doo łahgo ályaa da; «Ńdíídleeł» bee nináánídlé.

Eʼelyaaígíí áłtsʼíísígíí yaa íínísin, doodago eʼelyaaígíí bee naʼanishí biyiʼ siʼą́ą́ígíí nanishood. Áádóó bibąąh dah alzhinígíí bikááʼ ánílééh. Dooleełígíí bineʼgi dahalneʼígíí yishʼį́; háági ałtsʼįʼ ádoolééł tʼáá átʼéego yishʼį́. Nishʼnáájígo ałtsʼįʼ ályaa lágo bikaaʼ ałnáás; bitłʼááh ałtsʼįʼ ályaa lágo nishtłʼajígo ałnáás. Doodago eʼelyaaígíí áłtsʼíísígíí bił adílchííd, áádóó + bił adílchííd. Ałtsʼįʼ áshłééhgo eʼelyaaígíí áłtséhígíí (0, 0) gi siʼą́. Eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bibąąh aniłgééshgo eʼelyaaígíí bił ályaaígíí daatsʼí náánáshood. Ałtsʼįʼ ályaaígíí tʼááłáʼí łaʼ bikááʼ doo siʼą́ą da.

Eʼelyaaígíí bikʼidiilnííh. «Haʼátʼéegi? Tʼáá ákótʼéego» bee binástłʼah (deigo dóó nishtłʼajígo) X/Y ánéeltʼeʼ (px: 0, 1, 2…) bikááʼ ánílééh. Eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ doo náánáshood da; tʼááłáʼí łaʼ bikááʼ siʼą́go bee hazʼą́.

«Niteelíjįʼgo tʼáá íłʼíní» dóó «Deigo ánízáád tʼáá íłʼíní» bee eʼelyaaígíí tʼáá ałtso tʼáá íłʼíní ádoolnííł; tʼááłáʼí eʼelyaaígíí niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád bighah doo łahgo ádoolnííł da. Px, neeznádiinjįʼ ałtsʼájíniłgo, «Tʼáá áłtsé áłtsʼíísígíí» doodago «Tʼáá áłtsé ntsaígíí» bikʼidiilnííh. «Niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád (áłtséédą́ą́ʼ) · Nináánídlé» bee niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád tʼáá íłʼíní ályaaígíí ádin, ndi bibąąh aniłgééshígíí tʼahdii ákótʼée.

Eʼelyaaígíí bikʼidiilnííhígíí tʼéiyá bitłʼááh nináánídlé. Eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ tʼahdii siʼą́; bił ályaaígíí daatsʼí ádinígííjįʼ náánáshood. «Yóóʼ ahishhan» bee éí eʼelyaaígíí tʼéiyá ádin. «Ńdíídleeł» doodago «Nááná» bee łahgo ályaaígíí nináánídlé. Eʼelyaaígíí biiʼ hééł ályaaígíí nanishood; ádinígíígi nanishood lágo eʼelyaaígíí tʼáá ałtso yishʼį́. Nílázhoozh naaki ałchʼįʼ doodago ałtʼąą nanishood: ntsaago doodago áłtsʼíísígo yishʼį́ nisin. «Tʼáá ałtso yishʼį́ nisin» bee eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bee tʼááłáʼí ályaaígíí tʼáá ałtso yishʼį́; niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád doo łahgo ályaa da.

«Hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós (PNG)» bee eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bee tʼááłáʼí ályaaígíí hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz. «Paint biiʼ łahgo áshłééh» bee eʼelyaaígíí AN Paint biiʼ hééł ályaa, eʼelyaaígíí siʼą́ą́ígíí bichʼą́ąhjiʼ; «Ńdíídleeł» bee nináánídlé. RAM biʼoh neelʼą́go, eʼelyaaígíí beʼelyaaígíí áłtsʼíísígíí choiníłʼį́, éí yishʼį́ lágo. Eʼelyaaígíí tʼáá áłtsʼíísígíí biniiyé tʼahdii RAM biʼoh neelʼą́go, niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád bikʼidiilnííhígíí doo yishʼį́ da; RAM biʼoh neelʼą́ą́ígíí baa haneʼ yishʼį́. Naaltsoos áłtséédą́ą́ʼ doo łahgo ályaa da. Eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bee tʼááłáʼí ályaaígíí Android biyiʼ hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz; nááná dináádááhgo ąą ályaa.

«Naaltsoos > AN Paint baa haneʼ · Bee hazʼáanii dóó áyiilaii baa haneʼ» biyiʼ Catrobat/AGPL bee hazʼáanii dóó bee naʼanishí áyiilaii baa haneʼ tʼáá átʼéego hólǫ́.

nv/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.

nv/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_bel.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.

«Díníʼį́į́ʼ», «Naashchʼąąʼ», «Naaltsoos», «Łahgo áshłééh» doodago «Ałtah áátʼeełgo nidaashchʼąąʼígíí» bikʼidiilnííh, éí bee naʼanishí yishʼį́ nisin lágo. Kʼaaʼ nahalin bee naʼanishí bitsʼą́ą́jí bił adílchííd lágo bee naʼanishí doo yishʼį́ da; nááná bił adílchíídgo yishʼį́. Deigo ánízáád bee dah alzhin lágo, bee naʼanishí nishtłʼajígo/nishʼnáájígo daʼálʼį́; bee naʼanishí łaʼ yishʼį́ nisin lágo nanishood. Azeeʼdóó ánízáád bee dah alzhin lágo, bee naʼanishí nishtłʼajígo deigo dóó bitłʼááh daʼálʼį́. «Naashchʼąąʼ» biyiʼ naashchʼąąʼ bee naʼanishí, «Bikʼidiilnííh», dóó «Biiʼ hééł áshłééh nisin» hólǫ́. Naashchʼąąʼ bee naʼanishí éí «Bee akʼeʼelchíhí», «Bee adleeshí», «Tó bee naʼashchʼąąh» dóó «Níłchʼi bee naʼashchʼąąh». «Bikʼidiilnííh» biyiʼ dikʼą́ągo heeneez dóó ahééʼídzoh tʼáá haʼátʼéego ályaaígíí hólǫ́. «Biiʼ hééł áshłééh nisin» biyiʼ ídzoh, eʼelyaaígíí áátʼéego ályaaígíí dóó saad hólǫ́. Bee naʼanishí nááʼíłʼínígíí bił adílchíídgo, bee naʼanishí níwohdę́ę́ʼ choiníłʼį́ʼígíí dóó siłkidígíí yishʼį́: deigo ánízáád lágo bitłʼááh, azeeʼdóó ánízáád lágo nishʼnáájígo. Nááná bił adílchíídgo bee naʼanishí dóó siłkidígíí doo yishʼį́ da doodago nááná yishʼį́. AN Paint tʼahdii naalnishgo, tʼááłáʼí bee naʼanishí kʼad choiníłʼį́ʼígíí tʼahdii hólǫ́. Siłkidígíí łaʼ yishʼį́ nisin lágo nanishood. Bikaaʼ naaltsoos bízhiʼ dóó bee naʼanishí tʼáá íiyisíí choiníłʼį́ʼígíí hólǫ́. Áyiilaii baa haneʼ dóó bee hazʼáanii: «Naaltsoos > AN Paint baa haneʼ · Bee hazʼáanii dóó áyiilaii baa haneʼ».

«Ałtah áátʼeełgo nidaashchʼąąʼígíí» biyiʼ FG/BG (bidáadi/bineʼgi), «Bidáadi dóó bineʼgi: ałnádeeshʼááł», «Łizhin / łigai» dóó «Siłkidígíí łaʼígo» hólǫ́. FG doodago BG bił adílchííd lágo, éí nidaashchʼąąʼígíí łahgo áshłééh. Bikaaʼígíí bitłʼááh nidaashchʼąąʼígíí íiyisíí dóó nidaashchʼąąʼígíí hashtʼeʼ siłtsoozígíí hólǫ́. Íiyisíí bidáadi biniiyé bił adílchííd; bineʼgi biniiyé yaa íínísin. Nishʼnáájígo 4 bee nidaashchʼąąʼígíí kʼad choiníłʼį́ʼígíí hólǫ́; bidáadi biniiyé bił adílchííd, bineʼgi biniiyé yaa íínísin. Nidaashchʼąąʼígíí łahgo áshłééh bee naʼanishí biyiʼ nidaashchʼąąʼígíí, honeycomb dóó «Siłkidígíí łaʼígo» hólǫ́. «Siłkidígíí łaʼígo» biyiʼ nidaashchʼąąʼígíí ałnaa, názbas, RGB, HSV, HSL dóó hex (6 ánéeltʼeʼ) hólǫ́. Nidaashchʼąąʼígíí ní choiníłʼį́ʼígíí áłtsé Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 dóó Copper #B87333 hólǫ́. Bidáadi biniiyé nidaashchʼąąʼígíí hashtʼeʼ siłtsoozígíí bił adílchííd; bineʼgi biniiyé, łahgo áshłééh doodago yóóʼ ahishhan biniiyé yaa íínísin. Nidaashchʼąąʼígíí biiʼ hééł ánílééh doodago ádinígíí bił adílchíídgo nidaashchʼąąʼígíí hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós bee naʼanishí ąą ályaa. Eʼelyaaígíí bineʼgi dahalneʼígíí doo yishʼį́ da. Eʼelyaaígíí baneʼgi dahalneʼígíí yishʼį́ʼígíí eʼelyaaígíí bichʼą́ąhjiʼ ályaa lágo, kʼad BG bee éí tʼáá ałtso ádoolnííł. Eʼelyaaígíí biiʼ hééł ályaa lágo tʼahdii bikʼidiilnííh; bikʼidiilnííhígíí choiníłʼį́ lágo, baneʼgi dahalneʼígíí yishʼį́ʼígíídę́ę́ʼ eʼelyaaígíí siʼą́ą́ígíí yishʼį́. Wikimedia Commons eʼelyaaígíí łigai bineʼgi ályaa, áádóó biiʼ hééł ályaa. Naaltsoos áłtséédą́ą́ʼ doo łahgo ályaa da.

«Díníʼį́į́ʼ > Eʼelyaaígíí yishʼį́ nisin»: nílázhoozh tʼááłáʼí bee nanishood; nílázhoozh naaki ałchʼįʼ doodago ałtʼąą nanishood lágo, ntsaago doodago áłtsʼíísígo yishʼį́, dóó eʼelyaaígíí nanishood. Nááná naashchʼąąʼ biniiyé «Nááná naashchʼąąʼ» bikʼidiilnííh doodago naashchʼąąʼ bee naʼanishí łaʼ choiníłʼį́. Naashchʼąąʼ bee naʼanishí choiníłʼį́ lágo nílázhoozh naaki bee eʼelyaaígíí nanishoodgo doo ídzoh ályaa da. Bitłʼááh nishʼnáájígo bee nanishoodígíí ałnííʼgi 100% ídzoh hólǫ́. «Ntsaago yishʼį́ nisin» dóó «Áłtsʼíísígo yishʼį́ nisin» 100% biłááh ádoolnííł lágo 100% gi deeskʼaaz; nááná bił adílchíídgo biłááh ádoolnííł. Bitsʼą́ą́jí «Tʼáá ałtso yishʼį́ nisin» bee eʼelyaaígíí dóó bikʼidiilnííhígíí tʼáá ałtso yishʼį́, ałnííʼgi ályaa. «Eʼelyaaígíí yishʼį́ nisin» biyiʼ 100% ałdóʼ hólǫ́; «Díníʼį́į́ʼ» biyiʼ px bitaʼgi ídzoh hólǫ́.

Łahgo áshłééhgo tʼahígo adíyį́nínígíí lágo, doodago AN Paint yóóʼ átʼííʼ lágo, kʼad eʼelyaaígíí beʼelyaaígíí tʼáá bíniʼdii hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz. Hashtʼeʼ siłtsoozígíí doodago tʼáá bíniʼdii hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós doo bííníghah da lágo, éí baa haneʼ yishʼį́. AN Paint nááná ąą ályaa lágo, eʼelyaaígíí beʼelyaaígíí, naaltsoos bízhiʼ, bee naʼanishí siłkidígíí, bikʼidiilnííhígíí dóó tʼahdoo ałtso ályaaí tʼáá ałtso nináányá. Eʼelyaaígíí beʼelyaaígíí tʼáásahdii hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz. «Naaltsoos» biyiʼ PNG; JPEG dóó HEIC (eʼelyaaígíí áłtséédą́ą́ʼ nahalin dooleeł biniiyé siłkidígíí łahgo áshłééh); dóó JPEG XL, WebP dóó AVIF (eʼelyaaígíí baa haneʼ łaʼ ádin dooleeł doodago doo ádin da) hólǫ́. «Hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós…» bee haʼátʼéego naaltsoos ádoolééł, siłkidígíí, dóó haʼátʼéegi bikʼidiilnííh. «Hashtʼeʼ ninílé» bee éígi nááná hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz. «Naaltsoos beʼelyaaígíí hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós…» dóó «Hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós dóó aniʼáád…» bee beʼelyaaígíí hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz; haʼátʼéegi «Hashtʼeʼ ninílé» doo łahgo ályaa da, kʼad eʼelyaaígíí tʼahdoo hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz da. «Hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós dóó aniʼáád…» Android aniʼáád áádóó bikʼijįʼ ąą ánílééh. Naaltsoos bízhiʼ bitsʼą́ą́jí sǫʼ nahalin yishʼį́go, eʼelyaaígíí łahgo ályaa; tʼahdoo hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz da. Tʼáá bíniʼdii hashtʼeʼ siłtsoozígíí bee naaltsoos (áłtséédą́ą́ʼ) doo łahgo ályaa da.

«Bikʼidiilnííh»: dikʼą́ągo heeneez doodago ahééʼídzoh tʼáá haʼátʼéego ályaaígíí naashchʼąąʼ. Biyiʼ nanishood lágo tʼáá ałtso náánáshood; dikʼą́ bee dichʼííʼígíí binástłʼah doodago bibąąh ałnííʼgi nanishood lágo haa níłtso łahgo ádoolnííł; názbas «Nánígis» bee dichʼííʼígíí nanishood lágo náánígis. «Niteelíjįʼgo: deigo ánízáád bighah» áłtsé bee hazʼą́; éí tʼóó ánássįįh lágo niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád tʼáásahdii łahgo áshłééh. Bibąąh bee dichʼííʼígíí bee éí bibąąh bikʼehgo haa níłtso łahgo ádoolnííł. Ahééʼídzoh tʼáá haʼátʼéego ályaaígíí bee bikʼidiilnííh lágo, eʼelyaaígíí bikááʼ ályaaígíí tʼahdii tʼáá ákótʼée, náánígis bikʼijįʼ dóó tʼáá bíniʼdii hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz bikʼijįʼ ałdóʼ. Siłkidígíí biyiʼ niteelíjįʼgo, deigo ánízáád dóó nánígis ánéeltʼeʼ yishʼį́. Bikʼidiilnííhígíí choiníłʼį́ lágo éí łahgo ádoolnííł; «Ńdíídleeł» bee nináánídlé. Tʼáá bíniʼdii hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz bee łahgo ályaaígíí tʼahdoo ałtso ályaaí tʼahdii hólǫ́. «Beʼeshłééh», «Aniłgéésh» dóó kʼad eʼelyaaígíí bichʼą́ąhjiʼ «Bikʼidiilnííh» bee eʼelyaaígíí łahgo ályaaígíí choiníłʼį́. «Tʼáá ałtso bikʼidiilnííh» «Łahgo áshłééh > Bikʼidiilnííh» biyiʼ hólǫ́; saad bikááʼ ánílééh bee naʼanishí bighaʼdę́ę́ʼ Ctrl+A naanish. «Aniłgéésh», «Beʼeshłééh» dóó «Biiʼ hééł ánílééh» bikaaʼ hólǫ́. Bikʼidiilnííhígíí ahééʼídzoh tʼahdii tʼáá átʼé; naaltsoos bineʼgi dahalneʼígíí doo yishʼį́ da.

«Eʼelyaaígíí bibąąh»: bibąąh aniłgéésh biniiyé biyiʼjiʼ nanishood, doodago ntsaago ádoolééł biniiyé bighaʼgi nanishood. Áádóó eʼelyaaígíí bibąąh choiníłʼį́. Biyiʼ ádinígíí ályaa lágo BG bee tʼáá ałtso ályaa. Dah alzhin yázhí (px) tʼahdii tʼáá átʼé haa níłtso. «Tʼóó ánássįįh» dóó «Ńdíídleeł» hólǫ́. «Eʼelyaaígíí ntsaago doodago áłtsʼíísígo ánílééh…», «Eʼelyaaígíí bibąąh: haa níłtso?» dóó «Eʼelyaaígíí ániidí» bee px doodago neeznádiinjįʼ ałtsʼájíniłgo choiníłʼį́; daatsʼí «Niteelíjįʼgo: deigo ánízáád bighah» choiníłʼį́.

«Ahééʼídzoh»: ídzoh naashchʼąąʼ; naaki nanishood lágo ahééʼídzoh ádoolééł. Binástłʼah ałtah áátʼéego heeneezígíí: binástłʼah bił adílchííd, ałtséʼ bikʼijįʼígíí naaki bił adílchííd doodago ałtso ánílééh. Dahólǫ́ǫ́góó ałtsʼįʼ ídzohígíí, tʼáadoo nidaʼałkaahí ádoolééł nisin lágo, ałtsʼįʼ nidaʼałkaahígíí tʼóó ánássįįh. Dikʼą́ągo heeneez binástłʼah názbas lágo, «Binástłʼah · Ałnííʼ dóó bibąąhjįʼ ídzooígíí (px)» bee nanishood; tʼááłáʼí bibąąh yázhígíí ałnííʼ bichʼą́ąhjiʼ doo bee hazʼą́ą da. Saad: eʼelyaaígíí bił adílchííd; saad bee álʼíní bikʼidiilnííh, saad bee álʼíní tʼáá ákótʼée yishʼį́, kʼad dooleełígíí yishʼį́. Siłkidígíí biyiʼ haa níłtso, ditą́, neidę́ę́ʼgo, saad bitłʼááh ídzoh, saad bitááʼ ídzoh, haʼátʼéegi ályaa, saad ałtsʼą́ą́, dóó saad bineʼgi BG hólǫ́. «Tó bee naʼashchʼąąh» éí «Naashchʼąąʼ» biyiʼ «Bee adleeshí» dóó «Níłchʼi bee naʼashchʼąąh» bitsʼą́ą́jí hólǫ́; ídzoh yáázhgo ádoolééł biniiyé siłkidígíí łahgo áshłééh. «Bee akʼeʼelchíhí», «Bee adleeshí» dóó bee naʼanishí haa níłtso bee nanishoodígíí 100 px jįʼ. Bee akʼeʼelchíhí áłtsé 1 px; niteelíjįʼgo bikʼidiilnííhígíí tʼahdii hólǫ́. Ánéeltʼeʼ bił adílchííd lágo ánéeltʼeʼ bikááʼ ánílééh. «Yaago heeneez», «Sǫʼ nahalin» dóó «Kʼaaʼ nahalin» éí náánáłaʼ eʼelyaaígíí nahalin: «Ahééʼídzoh» doodago «Biyiʼ tʼáá ałtso naashchʼąąʼ». «Díníʼį́į́ʼ > Dah alzhin (naashchʼąąʼ biniiyé)» bee tʼáá bíniʼdii naanish dooleeł, dah alzhin haa átʼé, dóó ntsaago dooleełígíí siłkidígíí yishʼį́. Dah alzhin haʼátʼéegi ádoolééł biniiyé nanishood. Naashchʼąąʼ bee dah alzhin bił adílchííd; áádóó dah alzhin nanishood lágo naashchʼąąʼ. Nááná bił adílchíídgo naashchʼąąʼ deeskʼaaz. Bee adleeshí dóó ídzoh siłkidígíí «Naashchʼąąʼ > Naashchʼąąʼ» biyiʼ tʼahdii hólǫ́. «Díníʼį́į́ʼ» biyiʼ dah alzhin doodago naashchʼąąʼ háági ályaaígíí ntsaago dooleełígíí choiníłʼį́; haa níłtso łahgo áshłééh. Naashchʼąąʼ siłkidígíí biyiʼ px bibąąh doo ałʼánígo ánílééh (anti-aliasing) dóó ídzoh doo ałʼánígo ánílééh ałdóʼ hólǫ́. Saad bee álʼíní 11 łaʼ hólǫ́; saad bee álʼíní bee hazʼáanii biyiʼ áyiilaii baa haneʼ dóó bee hazʼáanii tʼáá ałtso hólǫ́.

«Naaltsoos > Eʼelyaaígíí ąą ánílééh…»: Android naaltsoos bikʼidiilnííh bee eʼelyaaígíí bichʼą́ąhjiʼ ánílééh. «Naashchʼąąʼ → Biiʼ hééł áshłééh nisin → Eʼelyaaígíí náánáłaʼ» biyiʼ Android naaltsoos, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart dóó «Wikimedia Commons · Kéyah beʼelyaaígíí (Blank maps)…» hólǫ́. Android biyiʼ eʼelyaaígíí bikʼidiilnííh, doodago online eʼelyaaígíí baa haneʼ ąą ánílééh dóó «Eʼelyaaígíí choiníłʼį́» bił adílchííd. Eʼelyaaígíí hiił ályaa, tʼahdii bikʼidiilnííh. «Naaltsoos > AN Paint baa haneʼ · Bee hazʼáanii dóó áyiilaii baa haneʼ > Eʼelyaaígíí: áyiilaii, háádę́ęʼ, dóó bee hazʼáanii» biyiʼ URL dóó bee hazʼáanii hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz. RAM bee hazʼą́ągo eʼelyaaígíí niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád áłtséédą́ą́ʼ bee ąą ályaa. Siłkidígíí yishʼį́ lágo, éí niteelíjįʼgo/deigo ánízáád, px ánéeltʼeʼ dóó RAM ánéeltʼeʼ yishʼį́. Px doodago neeznádiinjįʼ ałtsʼájíniłgo choiníłʼį́, dóó daatsʼí «Niteelíjįʼgo: deigo ánízáád bighah» choiníłʼį́. Naaltsoos áłtséédą́ą́ʼ doo łahgo ályaa da.

«Naaltsoos > Eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bee tʼááłáʼí áshłééh…» bee eʼelyaaígíí 20 jįʼ bee naʼanishí tʼáásahdii ąą ályaa. Eʼelyaaígíí áłtsʼíísígíí naaltsoos bizhiʼ doodago háádą́ą́ʼ łahgo ályaaígíí bikʼehgo ałnaa ánílééh. Eʼelyaaígíí tʼááłáʼí bibąąh aniłgéésh doodago eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bibąąh aniłgéésh. «Niteelíjįʼgo tʼáá íłʼíní» doodago «Deigo ánízáád tʼáá íłʼíní» bee eʼelyaaígíí tʼáá ałtso tʼáá íłʼíní ályaa; eʼelyaaígíí tʼááłáʼí niteelíjįʼgo dóó deigo ánízáád bighah doo łahgo ályaa da. Eʼelyaaígíí áłtsʼíísígíí doodago siiʼą́ą́ígíí nanishood: nishʼnáájígo ałtsʼįʼ ályaa lágo bikaaʼ ałnáás; bitłʼááh ałtsʼįʼ ályaa lágo nishtłʼajígo ałnáás. «Haʼátʼéegi? Tʼáá ákótʼéego» bee binástłʼah (deigo dóó nishtłʼajígo) ánéeltʼeʼ (px: 0, 1, 2…) bikááʼ ánílééh; eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ doo náánáshood da, ndi tʼááłáʼí łaʼ bikááʼ siʼą́go bee hazʼą́. Eʼelyaaígíí bikʼijįʼ biiʼ hééł ályaaígíí bikaaʼ daʼálʼį́. Eʼelyaaígíí bikʼidiilnííhígíí tʼéiyá kweʼé ndinííł; łaʼ tʼahdii siʼą́, ndi bił ályaaígíí daatsʼí ádinígííjįʼ náánáshood. «Tʼáá ałtso yishʼį́ nisin» bee ntsaago doodago áłtsʼíísígo yishʼį́. «Hashtʼeʼ niníłtsóós (PNG)» bee eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bee tʼááłáʼí ályaaígíí hashtʼeʼ siłtsooz. «Paint biiʼ łahgo áshłééh» bee kʼad eʼelyaaígíí bichʼą́ąhjiʼ ályaa; «Ńdíídleeł» bee nináánídlé. AN Paint eʼelyaaígíí łahgo áshłééh bee naʼanishí tʼááłáʼí hólǫ́, bineʼgi dahalneʼígíí doo yishʼį́ da. Eʼelyaaígíí łaʼ bee tʼááłáʼí áshłééh bee naʼanishí tʼáásahdii hólǫ́.

«Naaltsoos > AN Paint baa haneʼ · Bee hazʼáanii dóó áyiilaii baa haneʼ» biyiʼ áyiilaii bee hazʼáanii (áłtséédą́ą́ʼ), bee naʼanishí dóó saad bee álʼíní áyiilaii baa haneʼ, bee hazʼáanii tʼáá ałtso, dóó díí bee naʼanishí tʼáá ałtso ályaaígíí hólǫ́. Bee hazʼáanii saad yíníłtaʼ biniiyé nanishoodgo «Tʼáá ałtso beʼeshłééh», «Bee hazʼáanii łaʼ» dóó «Ałtso» doo náánáshood da.
